summary: Silent fireball-like objects appeared and disappeared, sometimes in fleets, with no sound or apparent source.
description:

This one was first seen at 10:40 PM. Ten minutes later, my mom and my neighbor saw three of these fireballs flying in the same direction. Each disappeared at different times, but without a discernible pattern. The first fireball in the fleet disappeared after 1 minute and 26 seconds, the second after 1 minute and 50 seconds, and the third after 2 minutes and 36 seconds. These time frames are based on when I started recording. Another fireball appeared at the same location at 10:54 PM and vanished after 33 seconds. Later, at 11:08 PM, another fireball appeared in the same location and disappeared after a minute.
All the fireballs seemed to have appeared at the same location and flown in the same direction at different times. At first, I thought they might be drones, but I’ve never seen drones without flashing red and green lights. These fireballs didn’t flash any lights and maintained their color and brightness until they disappeared out of nowhere.

I kept scanning the skies trying to find more but they had left. It was moving at a casual speed, about as fast as a satélite, very smooth maintaining exact speed. These were not airplanes or satellites. summary: Object Description: Large, glowing white sphere, resembling a giant ping pong ball
description:
---
Summary of the Event
On the evening of December 30, 2024, while observing the stars in my backyard, I experienced a sudden and unexplainable sense that something was present in the sky. Without knowing why, I snapped my head toward the eastern sky, and at that exact moment I immediately saw it: a giant, glowing white sphere, resembling a ping pong ball.
At first sight, the object appeared between half a mile to one mile away, moving from east to west. It then passed almost directly overhead.
---
Object Behavior
After passing, the sphere stopped in mid-air less than half a mile to the east and hovered for about two minutes.
It then began drifting slowly north before returning to nearly the exact same spot where it had hovered earlier, remaining there for about one additional minute.
Following this, the object performed a series of radical, erratic maneuvers within a radius of about half a mile. These movements lasted for roughly five seconds and were unlike anything achievable by known aircraft.
The object then abruptly halted. About two seconds later, it suddenly shot off toward the south at a speed I can only describe as instantaneous, as though it had teleported or moved at…

summary: Direction observed: Southwest (toward the Tri-Cities / Hanford area)
description:
Number of witnesses: 1 (myself)
Weather: Clear sky, twilight (sun had set ~4:20 PM), light breeze from southwest ~5–8 mph, temperature ~35 °F
A bright, metallic-looking, perfectly spherical white/silver orb. No wings, no lights, no tail, no sound. It appeared slightly larger than Venus would at its brightest, maybe the size of a pea held at arm’s length. The surface looked smooth and reflective, catching the last of the sunset glow from the southwest.
Behavior:
The object remained completely motionless the entire time I watched it. It did not drift with the wind, did not rise or descend, and showed zero movement relative to the horizon even when I moved the phone around. I have 17 seconds of steady video and several still photos that show it locked in place.
How it disappeared:
I honestly do not remember exactly how or when it left. I was focused on recording and trying to keep it in frame, and the next time I looked up it was simply gone. I do not recall seeing it shoot away, fade, or move at all.
Attached evidence:

description:
5 people witness luminous objects moving in the sky, responding to Morse code signals during sighting in Campo Morão on 12/30/24
On December 30, around 1 AM, my four friends and I were at a cottage, in the middle of the woods, near the Boiadeira 487BR road, in Campo Morão. We were enjoying the night around a campfire when we looked up at the sky and saw something completely out of the ordinary. We saw at least five luminous objects moving in a way that definitely was not like stars. They moved forward, backward, up and down, in all directions, and formed patterns like a triangle, with lights turning on and off, creating complex shapes in the sky.
Since we were in the middle of the woods, without light and not much infrastructure, I always carry a microwave motor with me that I had used in other situations to improvise solutions. I adapted this motor to a tripod and a lamp, and when I saw what was happening in the sky, I decided to try to interact with the objects. Using the flashlight app on my phone, I sent signals in Morse code. Every time I turned the motor, the lamp flashed, and with that, I transmitted signals, like the term "Hi."

While driving south on I-35 in the late afternoon, I observed a strange object in the sky that caught my attention.

description:
Tonight around dusk, I witnessed something extraordinary over Masonboro Sound. I was out enjoying the evening when I saw a single flying object come off the ocean. It didn't have the typical sound of any aircraft I'm familiar with; it hummed quietly, unlike the distinct sounds of high or low bypass engines, turbojets, turbo prop, inline or even propellers of any type. What's more, it wasn't showing up on any flight tracker apps. The real kicker was when this object suddenly split into two - right before my eyes. There was no explosion, just a seamless division. Minutes after this event, a military AWACS flew by, which seemed to be trailing it.
I'm quite versed in aircraft identification, but this left me scratching my head. Could be some experimental drone or tech, but it definitely wasn't your standard UFO scenario.
Just sharing what I saw, and I'm still trying to make sense of it." I truly don't know what's real or fake anymore. I know what I just saw. The popping noise at 6 seconds was coming from whatever those things were.

summary: I witnessed a large orange orb of light, silent, low in the sky, traveling south to north
description: I went to let my dog outside around 8pm. I turned around and noticed an orange ball of light traveling south to north. It was silent. I was facing west and it appeared to be just west of Lake Wissota/Chippewa flowage. It didn’t have any strobe or beacon lights normally found on aircraft. The ball of light itself was larger than any singular light found on an aircraft. It’s difficult to approximate a size, but I would say it was similar to the size of seeing Jupiter or one of the planets when they are shining bright. The movement of the object was not erratic and the speed was constant. It moved slowly. I would estimate less than 200mph. I ran inside and called my wife outside and she witnessed it as well. It continued to move slowly to the north and then flickered out and disappeared. After checking the Chippewa Valley airport Metar, the ceiling was overcast at 1300ft. The disappearance was probably due to it entering the clouds. I’m a commercial airline pilot and I’m used to seeing aircraft, stars, satellites(including starlink), in the night sky. I’ve never seen anything like this.

summary: Two solid orange lights. No flashing (FAA lights) or sound.
description: Walking the dog on the evening (~7:45PM Central Time) on Christmas Day (12/25/24). Saw two "Halloween" orange lights, similar to fire in the sky. At first, I thought they looked like consumer toy drones that some kids got for Christmas. They seemed to hover/float above the houses, maybe 15-20 feet over the rooftops. In retrospect, they resembled Chinese lanterns. The pair of lights moved independently, but in roughly similar directions. I did not take a picture at first, when they appeared low to the ground, because they seemed like innocent typical toy drones, what I thought was less than 100 yards from me. I continued walking the dog down the trail, with the lights to the East, but they were now behind me. I kept looking back to see them, and then it was clear that they were much higher than a toy/consumer-level drone should be able to fly and got to that level quickly. So quickly it was disorienting, as if they were never low to the ground at all. At that point I took a still picture, on an iPhone 16 Pro. Due to the low light conditions, it took several seconds to for the camera to take the picture. I called my wife, at the other end of the neighborhood (house pinned on the map…

summary: Seven sphere-light orbs that were hovering that seemed to materialize out of thin air.
description:
When stuck in traffic due to a serious vehicle accident that happened on the lane heading south, located about a mile or so away from the Quakertown exit off of i-476 interstate highway, I sighted several unconventional, mysterious crafts hovering to the right of the highway. About six to seven orbs or drones were hovering in the air and seemed to materialize out of nowhere.  I was not driving at the time, but rather was a passenger in the car, seated in the passenger seat to the right of the driver. Looking out my car window to the right of the highway lane, these mysterious crafts appeared to be small, spherical and had the appearance of of small drones; although they did not match the appearance of other SUV sized drones that social media and local news outlets have been inundated with. I took several pictures where several appear as red  lighted orbs, whereas in others they look appear look small orbs of yellow and/or white light. This all happened around 6:41 pm EST 12/25/24.
Being a pretty deep-seated skeptic most of my life, the usual commonplace explanations does not explain these orbs or mysterious craft in any meaningful or logical manner. These were definitely different…

There were approximately 6-7 visible lights at the time of initial sighting where then I observed 2-3 additional lights illuminate at the front of the formation. It initially looked like a fighter jet releasing countermeasures, until I realized that the lights were moving forward and not acting as countermeasures would. I relocated to try and get a better view of what I was observing, when approximately 5 minutes later the leading objects became extinguished. Leaving behind 3 objects that continued flying in a NW direction and seemingly took a holding pattern approximately 5-10 miles wide. The lights did not blink as typical aircraft running lights would. There was no audible noise coming from their direction as you would expect with fighter style aircraft, nor was their speed above what would be a stall speed for most fixed wing aircraft. Although we were both holding our phones, talking with the street lights on just 15 yards from us also with neighbors lights on in the horizon, etc the skyline we could see had a few stars, a plane flying higher in the sky when we both noticed the unusually brighter object flying seemingly closer than the plane and much, much faster. We were looking to the west which would’ve been towards the ocean and over the Gulf of Mexico, when this large flying object (drone?) flew very quickly from left to right so towards the east and in an upward motion. The light wasn’t blinking like a plane would but I think was white and maybe some yellow or red? As it flew quickly the most notable thing was that it just randomly disappeared. That was the scary part or startling aspect. We both saw it fly very quickly and then out of nowhere disappear in the sky. summary: A large object with lights flew low in the sky over the intersection.
description:
While driving on 429, my husband pointed out some bright orange lights in the distance, joking they might be UAPs. I started watching, and the lights dimmed and revealed blinking ones—something I’ve never seen before.
Later, while stopped at a red light (the sighting marked in this report), an object flew directly over us. We rolled down our windows as it approached. It was huge—maybe even the size of a bus—silent, and low. I couldn’t see its shape, just the lights: green on the right, red on the left, and two white bright lights in the center of the red and green facing downward toward us. There was also a lighter white light at the back and maybe other lights that I don’t remember the locations.
I pulled up a flight radar right after it passed over our head, but nothing showed up for that location. I can’t explain it, and it’s been replaying in my mind ever since.

summary: Bright sphere flew over us and stayed there for 20 minutes
description: A very bright orange sphere flew from the horizon (east) right next to the evening star. At first we thought it was the ISS but when it suddenly just stopped moving, we also stopped and watched the sphere. It was extremely high. Light clouds passed beneath it and yet it remained visible. The evening star, however, was not bright enough to shine through the clouds. We know that it is an approach zone of the nearby airport and are therefore well acquainted with aircraft in the area. It didn't have any flashing lights or anything like that. It glowed a solid orange. Several airplanes flew past Cologne Bonn in the sky during this time. At some point thicker clouds came along and we could no longer observe it. From the approach of the sphere on the horizon to the gathering of the dense clouds, about 20 minutes passed.

summary: As I looked west, I saw three star-like objects moving south to north come together to form a triangle and then disappear.
description: On December 23, 2024 at about 5:30 a.m. Eastern time, I was looking westward through a mullioned window at the stars. The sky was clear. Orion and Taurus had set. Jupiter was still visible. I noticed that what I thought was a white star moving from left to right – south to north – and decided it was a satellite. It was about 65 degrees above the western horizon. Then, I saw two more star-like, white objects that were moving south to north. Never seen anything like this in my life and it kept me awake all night last night contemplating what I had seen.

summary: Luminous, translucent but robust glowing orb with internal geometry “parked” above the airport.
description:
I observed a glowing spherical object hovering above the Milwaukee airport. The object appeared gold-amber in color and remained visible for over 30 minutes. To the naked eye it could have been mistaken for an unusually large, bright planet.
After observing the object with binoculars, I was able to clearly see that the sphere was translucent and contained internal motion or undulation, rather than appearing static. Inside the glowing sphere was a thin, crisp and solid-looking equilateral triangular outline. The edges of the triangle were the same color and glow as the rest of the sphere, giving the impression of a bright, reflective, metallic-like shape suspended within the orb.
The triangle appeared 2-dimensional but was clearly located inside the glowing volume, not on the surface. It did not move or rotate during the time I observed it.
The object remained stationary at first, but after approximately 25 minutes it slowly drifted downward at a steady rate until my view was blocked by a tree. The light intensity did not change during this descent, and the object did not blink, pulse, strobe or dim.
No sound was heard.

description:
Several lights were turning on and off in different directions.
I was watching a plane passing in the sky when, near it, I saw a white light "turn on," which moved eastward and then "turned off." Shortly after, other lights appeared and did the same; some of them moved northward.
I asked another colleague who was on duty with me to witness the event, and together we tried to decipher what it could be.
The number of objects appearing varied, at one point reaching around six at the same time, moving in different directions. I was able to make several recordings; this phenomenon seemed endless, only becoming impossible to see due to the brightness of the sunrise.
All the objects were circular, and when they moved, they seemed to become oval-shaped. There was a fixed luminous point, possibly a star, slightly below and to the right of the Southern Cross constellation, and all the appearances occurred around that area.
I didn’t hear any noise coming from them.
At one point, I called my wife, who was about 100 kilometers away from where I was, and asked if she could see these lights, indicating the area of the sky to look at. She then confirmed that she could see them and even recorded…

It wasn’t an airplane or a drone because it was sometimes slower, sometimes faster. Additionally, it blinked irregularly and sometimes turned off its light, only to turn it back on again. summary: Multiple lights flying up from the ground in erratic pattern, then fading out as they went upward.
description: I have a line of trees that runs behind my property. From my backyard I could see white lights floating upward from over top of those trees in an irregular motion from that of fixed wing aircraft, and I couldn't hear any helicopters or see any FAA compliant navigation lights. The red and green blinking lights that are usually indicative of drones. This was at night and the lights may have been upwards of a couple miles from my vantage point so they might've been a couple hundred feet in the air? The lights would rise up one or two at a time at a pretty decent pace, then would fade out as they got to a certain point above the horizon. This happened over and over for about 10 minutes. At one point I watched one zip along the horizon and looked like it split into two lights but it also could've been just two lights and convenient timing from my perspective on the ground. All I know is that I spend a lot of time looking at the night sky at my house and I haven't seen those lights before, nor have I seen them since. It was out of place. I'd also like to mention that I'm a professional videographer. So I have a ton of experience flying drones and flying in and filming out of helicopters…

summary: Multiple drone-like craft
description: From 7:30 PM to 9:30 PM I observed drone-like craft with a diamond shape and 5-6 six lights (white and red). The lights did not appear to be a typical of commercial aircraft, and did not resemble the patterns of the beacon, strobe, or navigation lights of airplanes. I observed them pass overhead beneath clouds, and I could see the bottom of the craft. I confirmed that these were not commercial aircraft by comparing the flight activity in my area on flightaware.com. A few of the UAPs were flying over Bethlehem in loops, and then heading eastward towards New Jersey. During the two hours I spent observing them I believe I saw at least 25 or more of them, despite poor visibility and cloud cover.

Both objects appeared as a ball of light (like a star) and had no trails behind them or any flashing or navigation lights. These were not drones, planes, satellites or asteroids. summary: A star-like UAP fades eastward over the ocean. Moments later, the light reappeared, this time moving south.

At 6:02 AM, I observed a UAP for about a minute and a half. The UAP appeared as a single, star-like light source moving through the sky, primarily heading east with a slight southern drift. During the sighting, no other planes were visible in the sky.
I tracked the UAP from a position west of where I was standing, watching it move eastward past the airport and over the ocean. Its movement was slow and steady, distinct against the stationary stars. Toward the end of the sighting, the UAP's light faded as it continued eastward over the ocean. Moments later, the light reappeared, this time moving south at a similar speed before disappearing from sight.
This report was furnished as soon as possible after the event.

summary: Saw UAP/UFO/Drone heading ENE coming from across the Mississippi river out of the SSW in a line directly over our Airforce base.
description: Saw UAP/UFO/Drone heading ENE coming from across the Mississippi river out of the SSW in a line directly over our Airforce base here in Southern Louisiana. It was being trailed in a parralel position by a single engine plane that I believe to be an FBI reconnaissance aircraft. The orb/UAP/drone seems as though it was moving at about 400+ mph and may have been simply toying with the trailing aircraft. The aircraft following it was definitely moving at it's maximum capabiities for that type of aircraft. I also witnessed several aircraft moving in slow crossing patterns following this sighting for about an hour or so. They moved in hold type patterns or to say they moved slowly as if to be looking for something or doing simple aerial reconnaissance. I am a past lineman that worked for the New Orleans Lakefront airport and have seen the trailing aircraft in the past which is how I came to the positive ID of it. I did not have time to get the act on camera as it happened rather quickly.

summary: It wasn’t a star.
Fleet of green orbs over Plainfield, CT
description: My girlfriend and I got home from work at around 5:35 and saw a bright green orbs very high up overhead. As we stepped back to look up further, we noticed TONS of them. They were flying in every direction. We watched as two of them flew together in unison, got very close together and then further apart. We stood outside watching for a while--they would pop up over a hill and fly over head--some disappearing into nothing and others flying further past our line of view. We watched for at least 45 minutes before the orbs disappeared for good. I was sick to my stomach and felt like I was going to pass out but it may have been fear or panic setting in. I tried to take video but it came out horribly. We waited to see if anyone else would report but heard nothing. I finally felt like it was best to report. I've never seen anything like it in my life. It was unreal. Just after we came inside, a helicopter or drone flew over our house and circled for hours. There may have been more than one circling. I've lived here for a long time--never seen a helicopter flying in this town and definitely not that low.

summary: Drone-like activity
description: From 5:30 PM to 10 PM, there have been drone-like objects in the sky, which appear to be triangular or diamond-like in shape. This is the third night that I have observed them in this same location (South Side Bethlehem) with the same set of behaviors. Most traverse from a north to south direction, but others travel in various other directions as well. They take, on average, 5 minutes to traverse the sky. There is, on average, at least 3-5 of them in the sky at any given time. They tend to appear a few at a time, but on average at least 1 appears about every minute. I estimate seeing about 50 craft per hour. They don’t fly in any particular configurations. Some leave a trail behind while others do not. The ones that leave a trail have the same type of lights that the ones without a trail have. Their lights flash red and/or white, with some only flashing red lights. The blinking patterns change often on the same craft (and between different crafts), although sometimes the pattern is consistent, and there appears to be 3-4 lights on the craft. Sometimes, one light will stay steady while three other lights complete a variable sequence of flashes. Sometimes the lights flash in a way…

summary: Saw at least more than 50 small lights in the sky, moving at a very fast pace
description: I went outside with my dogs at roughly 5:25-5:30 PM. At that time, my husband had pulled in the driveway from work. I looked up because like everybody these days we are all looking up because of drone sightings. I saw what appeared to be a night sky loaded with stars but a lot of these lights were not stars. They were not twinkling and they were moving at a very fast pace. Not fast like a meteor shower. They appeared to move with more intent. They appeared to move from Northwest to south east. There were so many in the sky that I couldn’t count. This definitely wasn’t Starlink. I’ve seen that before. These were more random. Their placement in the sky appeared to be random. The best thing I could compare it to is when I saw the international space station move across the sky, but these dots seem to be smaller and definitely moved more rapidly and there were so many of them that I couldn’t count. One of the small lights appeared to get bigger and brighter and then disappeared but I only saw one of them do that. There was no sound. As a matter of fact, it was almost eerily quiet at that time, and neither one of us recall, seeing any other type of routine aircraft in the sky during…

summary: Spotted with the naked eye from the home garden. strange movements on a windless day, south of Brazil
First 2 drones appeared, then the rest. In the EarthCam live that had a camera in seaside park.
description: I was following the live broadcast of earthcam, which had a camera in seaside park, NJ. summary: Dark Chevron Low Over Trees

summary: Saw orange orb in sky
description:
Report of UAP Sighting
While driving east on the highway from Surrey to Abbotsford, a few minutes after passing the 232 Street exit, we saw an unusual orange light crossing the highway from south to north. Initially, we thought it might be a drone, but as we got closer, we could clearly see the object.
It appeared to be a translucent sphere with a bright orange glow at its center. The light wasn’t pulsating, but it also wasn’t steady—it resembled an orange plasma ball.
As we drove under an overpass with a streetlight on it, we estimated the object’s altitude. It was about twice the height of the distance between our car and the streetlight, far too low for conventional aircraft but higher than what we’d expect from a drone.
The object wasn’t something with a light attached—it was the light. Its structure was visible, and it seemed self-contained. We tried to keep it in sight, but it was dark, and we were driving at 100 km/h on the highway.
We turned around at the 264 Street exit and backtracked to locate it but couldn’t find it again. The object was moving fairly quickly and staying just above the tree line.

summary: Triangle drone

We then moved a few feet southward to view the southern horizon and similarly saw at least 5 “drones” moving left to right as well as right to left over the same amount of time. Usually, 2-3 “drones” were visible at a time. These were far in the distance: 10x50 binoculars did not provide a clear view. The objects flashed red-white/red-white or red-red or white-white. We checked the Flightradar24 app and did not see any planes or helicopters anywhere remotely close to the area at the time, leading us to conclude that these were the unidentified “drones” being seen across the country at this moment.

summary: Bright white object continuously hovered in the air for close to 2 hours. Captured on video and in a still photo.
description:
At 6 PM on 12/14/24, I looked out a bedroom window and saw an enormous bright white light a few miles out in the distance, just hovering right above the treetops. The object was silent. The setting sun in the horizon really emphasized the light when I then noticed it was slowly creeping forth in a straight line and then stopped. It was slightly windy conditions, and this object had no problem withstanding those elements. It hovered perfectly in place as the white light fluctuated constantly—flickering big and bright. And upon going outside to dispose of some garbage, that’s when I looked up and got a good look of the event.
Right before I started recording, there were two airliners that were coming to and from Paine Field, which is 3 miles from my home. The planes flew right past the lit object. But the strange thing was, the air traffic for Paine Field got unusually quiet. Especially when the flight path is right over our house. I was able to get video of the object—not knowing if it was a drone (as there were a few really faint flickers of green and red lights that are better seen in the video than when I saw it with the naked eye in real time) or if this was a UAP/UFO…

They generally came from the north heading south, but some were coming from the north heading west or east, while others were coming from the west heading east, or from the east heading west, and a few came from the south heading north. Most, however, were going north to south or from the north to the east. At closest approach they were a few hundred feet above me, but most were further away. As I had seen the previous night, some left trails behind them, while others did not. summary: 3 flashes of green light from oval object in sky.
description: I was lying in bed at 6:32am when I saw a bright flash of bluish green light illuminate the clouds outside of my bedroom window. The flash lasted for the duration of less than a second. (It was raining very heavily and the wind was at 14 mph.) 5 seconds later I saw the second flash of light and I got up to look out the window. Another 5 seconds later I saw the third and final flash of light. During the flash of light, I saw a large oval-shaped light that was located inside the clouds. It was brief, but I could clearly make out the shape and direction of the light source. The light source was approximately 3 miles from my location. It was not moving. There is no man-made object located in that direction and at that altitude that would produce the light. I had the window cracked open, so after the third flash of light I heard a sound that I can only describe as metal and stone grinding against each other. The sound lasted for approximately 3 to 4 seconds. That was the conclusion of the sighting.

summary: Mothership and at least 2 other crafts
description: Will start by saying idk if it was drones, UAPs, or what. But we saw what appeared to be a brighter "mother ship" that was either onboarding or maybe fueling up smaller drones? It was hovering the entirety of the 30-45 minutes or so we were awake. We also saw lights shooting very fast across the sky that were neither fireflies nor shooting stars. We were inside the house looking out the window and they were coming from above our house so maybe they were coming from other crafts we couldn't see, I'm not sure. But then there were other crafts with blinking lights hovering near the tree lines. And then some appeared to have no lights at all and we're going towards the "mother ship" of sorts.

summary: Unlit crescent moon shaped craft flying over very loud airplane sound and orbs that looked like mini shooting stars flying from craft
description: I was at my home in Canfield Ohio and kept hearing what sounded like low flying loud airplanes flying overhead. It kept happening repeatedly from midnight on. So finally around 2:30 am after hearing this numerous times, I decided to go outside and see what was happening. I turned off all of my property’s exterior lights so I could see better and took a 13,000 lumen flashlight with me. I kept hearing the craft flying over and that’s when I noticed a crescent moon shaped craft flying overhead with no lights on it and what appeared to be mini shooting stars quickly shooting out of it and going in multiple random directions. I used my phone to look up if there was a meteor shower because I kept seeing these orbs shooting around and could hear the louder crescent shaped craft flying even though they were difficult to spot with no marker lights visible. I then witnessed some actual shooting stars from the meteor shower and they were noticeably different as they were larger and obviously more distant. I heard someone in New Jersey report the same exact incident around the same time. He made a post on Reddit about it. There’s obviously something very weird happening here.

summary: Large ball of light sighted to the east, less than 200 feet away, flying away from me at incredible speed, and hid behind a building.
description: I was walking on the sidewalk on my way home from a convenient store when this happened. The entire encounter lasted maybe 2 seconds. Out of the corner of my eye, I saw a very large, singular concentrated bright ball of light overhead that was white in the center and light blue around the edges. The object was maybe 200 feet in the air. However, the light did not appear to illuminate the environment around it. The object emitted no sound. I sensed that this object knew that I had seen it because it immediately tried to get out of Dodge as soon I had made direct eye contact with it. It flew in a downward and away direction towards the east/ northeast at incredible speed, disappearing behind a nearby building. I started to head in the general direction of where the object may have gone but I saw no indication that the object was still around. The encounter happened so fast that I did not even have time to film it. No trail or exhaust or anything like that.

summary: Observed white orb descend from northwest and immediate deviation westward

Sighting of unidentified aircraft was 1-2 seconds. Aircraft produced no mechanical sounds akin to any aircraft or drone propeller; jet engine. Only noise observed from object was the sound of its physical force against the wind.

Couldn't have been a drone of any kind for the speed it was travelling. It was so large, bright, and fast that it immediatedly took my attention to outside, where I saw it sort of go in a curved trajectory disappearing over the foothills horizon.

Neither one of us have seen anything like this in our decades on this planet.

summary: Viewed light drop extremely quickly from a low altitude straight down and did not reappear
description:
Got off of the exit, stopped at the stop sign, looked up and saw a small bright green light drop from a low altitude (approximating 200-300ft in the air) at a high speed. Sighting lasted only a few seconds and the light did not reappear. As it dropped, the view was obscured by trees and the Outback Steakhouse building. It dropped way too fast to be a drone, as if being propelled downward rather than falling with force of gravity. Only one color. Unsure of size but from the viewing distance, I could approximate its size being between baseball and football size, but round.
My mother has told me about seeing a fast dropping light similar to what I observed but she never officially reported it (she saw one while driving in the desert in NM). I am a licensed private pilot and know the difference between an aircraft and a mysterious light. The night after this, I observed a white light (acting differently) in another town (will make separate report). I was only in the sighting area for about a minute or two waiting to turn off the exit ramp but kept my eyes on the sky and didn’t see anything else.
I don’t mind if an investigator wants to contact me but I don’t need to be contacted if…

This location is in dark sky country in the middle of the National Forest, less than 15 miles from a municipal airport. I see satellites every night. I have seen the ISS go directly overhead. I saw a Starlink satellite train move across the sky 3 years ago. I have never seen a satellite or any other plane/aircraft up here that has displayed this type of illumination.
Any insight on this would be greatly appreciated.

summary: Multiple craft with red and white flashing lights, unusual flight patterns, no noise, and many "hovering" over city skyline.
description:
Driving north on I-35 through Burnsville, Minnesota, I noticed multiple small aircraft with flashing lights moving in flight patterns that are atypical of the usual sky traffic. They moved up and down, and changed direction faster than commercial aircraft. They were probably the size of a large suv, had 2 lights on the front, and one on each wing. From what I could tell they had wings, but were angled down. Most of them seemed to come from the east, where they would have passed over MSP airport, some stayed over the city skyline, some continued to the west/northwest. At one point a group of 3 came together before splitting into different directions. 2 of them had lights that flashed faster than the rest. None of them ascended/descended in a way that indicated they were departing from or arriving at the airport. I called my dad who lives in Minneapolis to confirm, and he could see some from his house as well.
I will note too that 1 or 2 seemed to be just orbs, with no physical "body", but those were never close enough for me to confirm this.
I work in the aerospace industry, albeit in a limited capacity, but have never seen anything like these.

summary: I saw a circular, silent object emitting green-purple lights. It moved erratically, disrupted the radio, and vanished quickly.
description:
When I got near the city, I saw something very large emitting lasers. It made no sound, and the radio signal started failing too.
On the night of December 13, I was traveling with some friends in a remote area, enjoying the calm and the starry sky. Suddenly, an intense light caught my attention. At first, it looked like a star, but I soon realized it was moving erratically, unlike anything I had seen before. The light had a green and purple hue, flashing almost hypnotically. It felt strange, as if the object was getting closer.
Additionally, the radio signal started failing, as if there was interference, which made the situation even more tense. The object was circular in shape, very distinct, and moved quickly, changing direction without making any sound. After about three minutes, it disappeared in the blink of an eye, leaving us all in silence, unsure of what to think.
What happened that night still makes me question whether it was real or just my mind playing tricks on me.

My Wife witnessed the ones after the huge swarm was gone. I was scared and didn't report to 911-I honestly don't know what they could have done anyway.

summary: I went to my window and I saw a a bright light moving towards my direction and to my surprise it stopped and sat in the sky for 30 min.

This is the first time I have seen a UFO sitting in the sky a long time like that! My husband is a witness as well. summary: V shape craft flew car with green/white flashing objects accompanying it
description:
Driving home from an appointment in Memphis, my spouse and two children spotted what we at first assumed were weird and brightly lit cell phone tower lights.

It had three bright orange lights in the middle, with white/green flashing lights above and below. As we traveled northeast towards the lights and they traveled southwest towards us, it became clear that they were not part of a tower, despite being about that height from the ground.
The green/white lights seemed to take up positions in front of and behind the orange lights as they got near. I never got a good look at the shape of the green/white objects, despite two of them flying low and past our car, moving behind the tree line.
The orange lights, however, flew directly over our car. I was able to clearly see the craft as I leaned out my open passenger window, with the moon behind it. It was a flat black-looking V shape, with the bright orange lights on the three points. It made no noise that I could hear over the open window, despite having my head outside of the car and it being so low.
I did see a smaller red light flash as it flew over, but…

At first, we thought it might be a plane or helicopter, but it remained completely still and silent. After we turned around to get a better look, the craft suddenly zoomed away, heading west before making a sharp turn and going south. It moved at an incredible speed, far outpacing our car, and vanished in seconds, leaving no sound or trace. The whole encounter left us feeling unsettled, as it seemed completely out of place, especially over a residential area.
No pictures, I'm sorry. It was too fast.

summary: Weather Conditions: Clear and sunny
description:
Report:
While driving my son-in-law to work, I observed a large, matte black aerial craft that appeared to be a drone flying at tree line level. The craft was approximately the size of a large SUV or a “short bus.” Prior to its appearance, I heard a low humming noise for about 20 seconds. However, the sound abruptly stopped a few seconds before the craft came into view.
The object had a strikingly wide body and two arms or “wings,” but I did not notice any visible propellers, lights, windows, doors, or vents. Its surface was entirely matte black, and it lacked any visible markings. The craft flew silently as it passed overhead and continued over the tree line into the distance.
The absence of lights was likely due to the bright daylight conditions at the time. What stood out most to me was the craft’s unusual width and its silent, gliding motion, which seemed inconsistent with typical drone or aircraft behavior.

summary: A single glowing orb hovered silently above the treetops, emitting a pulsating blue light, before accelerating out of sight.
description:
Around 9:30 PM, while walking in a clearing in a wooded area, I noticed a bright, pulsating orb hovering approximately 45 degrees above the horizon. The craft was spherical in shape, silvery metallic in color, and emitted a blue glow that pulsed rhythmically. It appeared stationary for about 30 seconds before it moved erratically, shifting direction multiple times, and then accelerating at an extraordinary speed, disappearing into the night sky without a sound.
There were two witnesses, including myself, both with clear visibility of the event. The estimated distance from the object at its closest approach was about 500 feet, and its size appeared comparable to a compact car.

summary: What looked like a plane heading my way disappeared
description: While looking out my back door I saw a plane heading my direction. As the plane approached closer I saw another plane on the same flight path right behind it. I stepped outside, as I was letting my dogs inside, I could hear the jet engines of the first plane as it approached. As the plane passed overhead I could see the plane until it passed over my house and went out of view, I could hear the jet engines fading. I looked at the second plane and it was at a spot where I should be hearing it but I do not. I step inside my house real quick to grab my phone off of the kitchen counter so I can take a photo of it. When I am back outside the lights are at a 55 or steeper degree angle up and still no sound, the lights go behind a fast moving small cloud crossing its path for a couple seconds after which it should be right overhead, I look at my phone, while the cloud blocks my view, to turn camera on. I look back up and there is nothing, the cloud continues on it way and there is no sign of a second plane. I downloaded the FlightRadar24 app and it showed the first plane (united express UA5352) which was from Chicago heading to Akron, but it showed that there was no second plane. The…

summary: Saw 4 UFOs - orbs bouncing and changing directions, speed, and shape rapidly. Also saw countless drones and airplanes.
description:
I live on a secluded waterfront property next to a nuclear power plant in Prince Frederick, MD. I went outside last night, and I saw a glowing orb that was changing shape and colors moving throughout the sky and kind of a bouncing pattern. It was coming from the area of the nuclear power plant going towards my house, and then there was also another one coming from the area above my house towards the nuclear power plant. In total, I saw four, each came at a different time from the other one, but in very close succession, and from one of the two directions that I just described. It would appear like it was coming closer to me. At the closest point it was approx 300 ft away from me. The footage is shaky because I was not looking at the camera and I was excited. I saw it changing color and shape in the sky and it confirmed it when I zoomed it in.
I also saw several drones. These were triangular shaped flying object objects with a steady white light or a red light or red and white lights, but not like that of an airplane, and not moving in the same path that the airplanes fly, and extremely high in the sky.I’ve been outside every night for a week and a half, and this is my first time…

summary: I let my dog out and saw a white/blue light
description: I'm an avid star gazer and tonight I was letting my dog out and while standing in my kitchen I look above my neighbors house and saw a small, single, round, white light and blue aura zoom past and disappear quickly. I know the difference between satellites, meteors, and comets, all which this wasn't. This object was unidentifiable but I can say for certain it wasn't any of the three mentioned above. I'm former military thats currently a nursing student that does not use drugs or alcohol so I know it wasn't something I imagined or mistook for simple aircraft. It's possible it's advanced technique I'm unaware of but it doesn't seem likely.

summary: Multiple aircraft spotted in south haltom city, white aircraft with white red and green blinking lights unregistered crafts
A large black angular shaped craft with several bright red orbital brilliant lights pulsating , gyrating, silent hovering
description: I was lying in bed when I saw a bright red light outside my bedroom window , hovering over my property. I bolted out of bed , thinking it might be one of those drones being sighted in NJ.When I ran out onto my back deck to see it it was directly over my head and I looked up and was absolutely stunned, shocked, riveted to see an actual craft of some kind. It looked angular in shape because I could see the edges of the craft and it had sharp corners like a rectangle or octagons shape or triangle. The glare was so bright that it blurred out the far end of the craft. It was large like maybe 500 sq ft. I could see it very clearly because I saw the round large recessed gyrating brilliantly orbital light in the center with several more slightly smaller ones surround it. Also gyrating like an energy source. I could act see the black edges of the recessed metallic area that the lights were set it. These lights put off a type of light energy that was different than any like I’ve ever seen. I wasn’t scared but I began to shake like a leaf all over my body, I could literally feel my bones rattling throughout my body. I was transfixed, mesmerized because when your brain realizes suddenly that…

summary: I seen multiple things in the sky that did not resemble airplanes or helicopters
Sat in same spot for an hour then moved slowly over time the opposite direction of the stars. Took distant video with phone.
Large craft flying slow and low without sound
description: While driving northeast on Brighton Ave, a large aircraft flew southwest above me, crossing my path. It was probably only 100 to 200 feet high. Moving approximately 65 mph. I viewed it entering my vision over the tree line to my right and flying off behind the tree line to my left. I opened my window to see if I could hear engines or propellers but I could not. It resembled a strange looking airplane with several lights on it. Light grey in color. There is a nearby airport but planes never approach from that direction. I commute to work on this road so I would know. There was a car in front of me that appeared to have no reaction to it.

summary: Very bright circular light under cloudline traveling slowly south/south west with object pulsing from white to blue, disappearing too
description:
I was traveling South on Highway 69 from Southern end of Verona, WI (after passing under Highway 151) headed South through rural farm land towards Belleville, WI. Object was circular, very bright at times but pulsed from white light to bluish to VERY bright white and then would periodically disappear and reappear erratically.
It had NO blinking flight lights. No sound (saw it after I pulled into my driveway and got out). It was moving slowly from north to south/south west. I saw it approximately for 20 minutes or so until it disappeared into southern horizon.
My teenage son came out and saw it before it was gone.
I’m a stargazer and love seeing air flight tech (planes, helicopters, drones, etc). This was very unusual, out of place, odd, and like nothing I had seen before. I always try to debunk.
It very well could be a mixture of strange lighting and perhaps a plane, helicopter, drone with malfunctioning lights that caused weird lighting and strange depth perception visuals, but this seemed just different and off.
It also was not Starlink or a meteor. I know what those look like.

summary: Sunset, sun coming in from horizon (below craft?)...
description: Wife and I went out on back deck because of the sun hitting the tree tops (because the sun was setting)... quite beautiful. We saw a large gray disc that was thick in the middle and moving at high speed within a confined area in the sky directly east of Free Union, Virginia. We saw it because the sun was hitting it directly at "eye level." Acrobatic moves and direct reverses and sharp angles and high speed where it covered what may have been 15 miles in one second, multiple times. It was a very clear sighting and it was NOT a plane or any other object that we could identify. We used binoculars to get a better view. Didn't know where my camera was. It lasted for about 3 minutes. I am an educated (retired) doctor.

summary: Silent, bright object filmed moving fast and stopping suddenly in the sky with no sound or visible propulsion, defying explanation.
We were exploring an abandoned house, we were taking photos, and when we looked through the camera lens, the flying object appeared.
description:
We were exploring an abandoned house, taking photos, and when we looked through the camera lens, the flying object appeared.
At the moment we wanted to take the photograph, the photographer noticed the object in the sky. We were amazed as it remained there for about 30 or 34 seconds, then it just moved away very quickly into the sky, in an extremely fast manner, making no noise.
Original report in Spanish:
Estábamos explorando una casa abandonada, estábamos tomando fotos y cuando miramos por el lente de la cámara salió el objeto volador
Al momento de querer tomar la fotografía, el fotógrafo se percato del objeto en el cielo nos quedamos asombrados ya que permaneció ahí durante 30 o 34 segundos aproximadamente después solo se alejo muy rápido haci el cielo, de una manera extremadamente rápida, no hacia ningún ruido

summary: Saw the actual being
description: Hello my sighting was not the craft but the actual being in my home , I’ve had unusual things happen beginning in Aug of this year, first thing was a crop like marking carved into my shoulder , I have pictures, many other things that have followed up until I saw what looked like a grey being in my home , this sounds soooo crazy but I am scared now,

summary: Appear to be TR3-B type craft with predominantly white lights with red lights
description:
Every clear night these craft appear in the same location. Same spacing every night. This evening I counted 8 objects. I have been witnessing these since early July 2024 along with other witnesses. When a “bright” focused beam of light is directed at them they light up brighter as if they are activated. When this happens a red light on them appears. I believe this red light is an an IR sensor (infrared). They remain stationary. With my aviation background as a Professional Pilot (ATP/A&P/IA) I am convinced they are a recon/surveillance type of drone engaging in ISR activity. I have witnessed these craft at numerous locations at many locations throughout the U.S.
I have recorded video evidence of a focused concentrated infrared beam (IR) scanning the area that I was previously standing while directing a powerful beam of light at them. It was an obvious IR scan of the area I was at. This IR light was detected by a security camera that detected IR activity.
I have used an ADS-B receiver to detect these craft to no avail. Other airborne targets appear (higher altitude airline traffic).
I have called a local ARTCC to report these craft and their radar does not detect any traffic in the…

summary: Cellphones may show it to be pulsating but with my own eyes it was as well
description:
Vacationing at brothers in Saucier, MS. I went out to smoke a cigarette at around 11:45pm as I had done the previous 2 nights (did not see prev) and as I was standing there I noticed the small flicker of colors but thought christmas lights but then I noticed with my bear eye it was pusalting for a moment and seemed to change shape. I pulled out the cell cam and started recording. I know cell cams can make a light seem to pulsate and twinkle but I had also saw this with my own eyes. The thing that got me the most was the gun fire that can be heard right when I start filming. I thought I heard it before filming but wasn't sure until I heard it in the video. The other thing was I noticed the crickets which could clearly be heard the previous night couldn't be on this night.
The neighbors house had no other visible decorative lights flashing or not elsewhere on the trim of the house or garage but only the christmas tree in the window.
The lights seemed to lower and rise again at one point. I did my best to keep it trained on it but I swear it was ducking behind the treeline. It was not a windy night.
I really don't know what to make of it. I actually forgot about it until I saw a…

summary: something warped then blue streak and then blue streak instantly gone
description:
Something warped then blue streak and then blue streak instantly gone
I was outside in the backyard. From looking down I looked up then something blue( I thought it was a star) warped (warped because the environment around it shapeshifted) incredibly fast, instantly fast, then blue streak(moved maybe west or down) then the blue streak was gone. I don’t know if blue streak was in front of the clouds or way way behind it (out of the atmosphere). Clouds did not move. No sound from “blue thing”. No sound from dogs around me. I thought it was a shooting star, but I don’t believe so.

summary: Blood red orb flying West to East at a low altitude.
description:
Like nothing I've seen before.
I'm a night photographer and had just parked my car, ready to set up kit for star and sky photos.  As I was just pulling my car into an unlit rural car park, I spotted a deep and almost blood red orb flying West to East at a low altitude. It was travelling incredibly fast and was soon out to sea.  There was no noise. The colour of red was unlike anything I've seen before - almost the fullest red you could imagine, like a 'whole' red, deep and without fault.
The flight path would have originated from close to Newcastle Airport, a few miles to the North of it. The only major place it passed over was Cramlington but given its speed, I doubt anyone would have spotted it.  The red orb then flew out to the North Sea.  The sighting was only for a short duration and I'm well used to seeing what our night skies contain. This was definitely something very unusual.

summary: I was looking through a flir camera (ulephone armor 18T) because I was followed by drones and orbs for days before. witnessed by others
description: 3 days prior I had come in contact with an orb of light. I already filed a report on that. Due to that I had seen orbs and drones hovering above me for days. These things were witnessed by my wife and and random bystanders. I was working that day driving a trailer truck. Carrying 20 tons of bird feed for chicken. I had problems with the rotor machine that pumped the feed. I needed to run out and unclog it many times. There was very little light as it was a cloudy night and it got dark hours before I arrived there. I used the flir to see better around me, but I was also checking if there were orbs or drones around. First off, stars and other bright objects do not show up on the flir. the moon was out of view and also behind heavy clouds. This could be something wrong with the flir itself however I have not seen this before or after on it. I will add the two videos I have of it. I have more videos where the object can't be seen anymore. I couldn't see the thing with my own eyes but it seemed pretty real on flir. Temperature was sub zero, with heavy wind. The direction of the orb is west as far as I can see. I taped the thing, ran to unclog the machine. Filmed the thing where it was…

summary: Several objects across the sky with white and red light. Hovering in place.
description:
We noticed a strange object in the air through our window, looking like a white and red light in the sky. The red light wasn’t blinking like on a plane, it was steady. It was also moving oddly in small zig zags. As we stepped outside to get a better look, something like a shooting star beamed across the sky. The red lit object was still there and as we looked around we noticed multiple others (~5). All with the same red and white light and hovering place. We watched for over ten minutes baffled, and they retained their position, and relative size. Also watched two planes fly by during this, so we are confident they aren’t planes. Could maybe be drones, but the coincidence of multiple being flown at 10pm in different areas of the sky seemed scarce.

summary: Very large low flying flat black triangle heading extract north helicopters flying
description:
Very large low flying flat black triangle heading extract north, no lights .. helicopters flying along prior and after … disappeared north .. lasted 30 seconds .
No noise except from helicopters
Moon was half full, so I was able to see this object.. It was very large and totally silent .

summary: Sighted several objects with flashing lights, hovering in place and then slowly moving a bit to another location within view.
description: My sightings began on 12/10/2024 about 5:30pm, while driving in San Diego County, north on Interstate 5 (I5) from Oceanside, CA, through Camp Pendleton and into southern Orange County. I saw 3 objects with flashing lights hovering in place about 1000 feet above the ocean, spaced out about 1/4 mile from each other along the coast, even off the coast of Camp Pendleton Marine Corp Base. They remained in view the entire time until when north of San Clemente, I5 curves east from the coast and those objects were no longer within my view. Upon entering the Laguna Hills area at about 6:00pm I began seeing several of these same type of flashing objects in the sky, hovering in place at several locations all over the areas both east and west of of I5 & I405 and notably many more of the same objects/lights were in the north sky on the way and closer to Orange County Airport. However, I took the offramp from I405 at Hwy 133, towards Laguna Beach and Quail Hill (where I reside). On the overpass, the flashing objects were still visible, but once I turned off towards Quail Hill, there were hills and a lot of trees, so I had limited view. I checked the sky for them outside on my driveway, but my…

summary: Two ufos, one circle with square lighting, and a triangle shaped one, we’re spotted over greenwood and Indianapolis.
description:
Object one “drone”
The first of the two seen at the same time was a square, well that’s what we thought at first at least. The lights were in a square formation on the bottom of it. When it got closer we could see it was in a discus shape.
Object two “The Bloody Imperial Navy” (my Aussie friend who’s a Star Wars fan called it that)
The UFO was triangular in shape, looked like a small star destroyer almost. The lights were in a triangular formation on the bottom. We figured out it wasn’t a plane when it got closer to land, being around 6000 feet.
The two ufos seemed as if they were looking for something, my friend joked maybe they’re looking for the matrix of leadership when I called him and told him about the ordeal.
My other friend (the Australian one mentioned earlier) saw them both on the edge of Indianapolis, an hour after I saw them, he then at the time called me and told me his ordeal.
Later in the night around midnight a chutnik helicopter and a Blackhawk flew over my house, which I believe could’ve been tracking them.

summary: ISS/bright satellite style object, but odd
description:
A light similar brightness and speed to ISS, flying west horizon, eastward. stopped, in the east, hovered for approx 15mins, decended, and changed shape/size.   Had time to grab binoculars for a better look. The object then returned towards the west.
Initial thoughts were, some sort of drone, but was dead silent, moved differently, and appeared too bright in the night sky to be one. (I have 4 drones and am familiar with their appearance and abilities in flight. This was not a drone)

location: Randolph Air Force Base, TX, USA
summary: Bright multicolored orb stationary in the sky
1,000ft high. Blinking white light not connected to anything like a cell tower. Flashed and the light
description: 800-1,000ft high roughly. Blinking white light not connected to anything like a cell tower. Flashed and the light shined in the overcast/fog. I was driving and didn’t hear anything. Kept flashing for 30+ seconds but I drove away from the location and lost sight. It stayed in one spot.

summary: Craft was hovering above our homes with no sound
5-8 orange orbs seen slowly rising into the clouds, all perfectly in a vertical row.
description: On 12/10/2024 at 19:45 hours I was driving a co-worker home from work when we were stopped at a stop sign and observed orange orbs in the sky. The orbs were west of us, slowly rising and all in a vertical row. The lights were all traveling directly up at the same speed, disappearing into the clouds, one by one. The orbs were also perfectly spaced out as if they were tied onto a rope and someone was pulling them up through the clouds.

summary: Multiple cell phone videos of blueish white "lights" that seemed to "dance" and chasing and zipping through the sky
description: While walking our dog at night on 12/10/2024 at approximately 7:24 pm, I noticed some types of quick flashes of light above us. When I looked up I noticed several sphere looking lights up in the sky. They were a blueish white light, making random movements as if they were flying around each other, almost dancing. I quickly grabbed my cell phone and hit record. At the time I did not think my cell was recording what we were seeing because when I looked at the screen I couldn't really see on screen what we were seeing in real time.it was so faint. Then suddenly the lights came together in one spot and then quickly shot out in like a starburst in all directions, very far and wide. Then nothing. My husband quickly brought the dog home and then came back out to watch with me. At that time, I reviewed my recording and was excited to see that my cell DID pick up what we saw. We continued to watch for over an hour as the lights came back multiple times, in various directions sometimes creating a sort of center and then shooting out from a combined center. At times it was like they came from miles and miles away from each other way up in the sky and joined so quickly and spurted out in like…

summary: It was in a m/w pattern all lights faced toward me, no blinking. No sound until it was to my right
description: Was driving and saw lights that I thought were stadium lights. They were facing toward me the whole time in a shape that resembled an M with dots on the end to also make it look like a W. They got closer and went directly in front of my vehicle a few miles above me, moved across the vision of my windshield and off to the right. I only heard sound after I could no longer see it and am unable to determine if the sound came from that or a legitimate airplane. It was large. Yellow/white lights. My son was with me and heard me react but did not observe what I did.

summary: 8-12’ long small scale fighter jet-like with angled surface - two fixed wings and 4 quad copter arms protruding in front of and rear
description:
The first observation was not on film but I couldn’t miss it heading away from the base down Yeamans Hall rd - it was just there hovering over a house. I saw it driving close up it was in the style of fighter jet with camouflage wrap , however, smaller scale and it was more of a shell made of metal in the shape of a jet. It looked like it was completely still, just hovering there, with four lights active revealing that it’s framework was more quad copter skeleton protruding through the shell of a body
Hovering with the lights active about 30’-40’ over the roof of home on side of Yeamans Hall Rd, approx. 8’-12’ long - shell structure was very similar to early to late F series USA fighter jets but not a smooth surface - more angled like anti-radar geometry even though it was well below radar minimum height detection - there were 4 quad copter arms protruding out in front and behind of the fixed wings. Solid red lights underneath flashing wingtip lights.
I back tracked to N. Rhett Rd for vantage point and have some video of the 8-10+ additional vehicles at various altitude - at least one that was several thousand ft in the sky at one point
The third encounter that night while…

summary: I thought it was the moon until I saw the real moon in the opposite direction
description: Held its position for about half an hour, then slowly started to descend until I couldn’t see it anymore

summary: At first I thought it was a satellite with the flashing lights then it started moving quickly and erratically back and forth zigzagging
description: It looks similar to a satellite from a distance until it started moving all over the sky with erratic movements changing directions seven or eight times in a split second then shooting all the way across the whole sky faster than anything I've ever seen and it was gone.

summary: Large drone with 3 bright white lights shaped similar to airplane, but way too low and flying too slow to be a plane.
I was driving my son to work that morning. I drive a Honda civic. We live in Morinville, and he works in St Albert. We left our home at 6:40 am and stopped at Tim Hortons for coffee and tea's, then…
description:
All of a sudden, this bright light comes towards the left side front of my windshield. I remember saying to my son , " I can't see, I just can't see anything and put my hand up as to block the light.
Meanwhile, my son says it was inside the car circular. When it came in, he pulled back away from it. He said it was silver and had a rim around it. He said there was no noise and it was in front of both of us in the car. Then all of a sudden, it was gone.
I said to my son. Did this just happen? He said yes, it did. It was weird cause I didn't brake or panic. I just kept driving. The weird thing is I realized when it was over I was in the exact same spot as it entered time had stopped during the event.

summary: Orb inside my car
description:
I was driving my son to work that morning. I drive a Honda civic. We living in Morinville, and he works in St Albert. We left our home at 6:40 am and stopped at Tim Hortons for coffee and tea's.  Then proceed south on Hwy 2 . I was driving in the left lane of the hwy, and there was an older model car behind me and a truck in front of us.   All of a sudden, this bright light comes towards the left side front of my windshield. I remember saying to my son , " I can't see, I just can't see anything and put my hand up as to block the light .
Meanwhile, my son says it was inside the car circular. When it came in, he pulled back away from it. He said it was silver and had a rim around it. He said there was no noise and it was in front of both of us in the car. Then all of a sudden, it was gone.
I said to my son. Did this just happen? He said yes, it did. It was weird cause I didn't brake or panic. I just kept driving.

summary: Over the Gulf of Mexico, orb object appeared as a shooting star, then made U-turn, flew around erratically before flying westward
description: My girlfriend and I were talking on the balcony of our cabin on the Carnival Dream cruise ship when my eye caught what looked like a shooting star in the night sky south of the ship. After shooting around the sky a distance, it made a U-turn (or more of a C-turn, actually) toward the southwest. It then speed up, then slowed down again, making some erratic turns at sharp angles and varying speeds. We heard no sound from it. But it was hard to judge how big it was or how far away it was. As it made its way to the southwest, it eventually disappeared into the clouds.

summary: Saw a triangular shape flying by the tree lines, had 3 lights on each point, honked my car & disappeared into tree lines
description: I was approaching a green light when before making a left turn I seen a triangular shape flying with 3 triangle lights on each point , it was moving very slow & hovering over the trees. When I noticed it I stopped my car in the middle of the intersection to stare at it, a car then approached behind me , honked at me & instantly the triangular shaped craft seamlessly disappeared into the tree lines , maybe turning lights off? Trees were about 30-45 ft high. I felt paralyzed in the moment , couldn’t move. Just stared at it wondering what it was.

summary: Turned off of Belair Drive onto Sun Way and spotted one drone sitting ahead in the sky. It was green and red flashing.
description: When the drone began moving, the lights all turned red. They are low and massive, the size of a small car or SUV. They are insanely loud. We saw jets at least 20 minutes after.

summary: Silent flying silver sphere acting as a drone.
description:
Flying silver sphere acting as a silent drone
A shiny silver sphere was seen from a third floor, not illuminated by its own light, resembling a disco ball flying from side to side at the height of the light pole without emitting any noise. It was observed very clearly at just 30 meters away.
Original report in Spanish:
Esfera plateada voladora actuando como dron sin ruido alguno
Se vio desde un tercer piso una esfera plateada brillante pero no por luz propia parecida a una bola de disco volando de lado a lado a la altura del poste del luz sin emitir ningún ruido. Fue visto apenas a 30 metros de distancia muy claramente

summary: UFO above Lake Nepessing to east
description:
My husband came home from work, was in the driveway for a while. He asked me to come outside. There was a bright flickering light in the sky that was really bright. It didn’t not move much it just hovered. We called our neighbor to come outside. The object seemed brighter than a star and lower than a star. It just sat there. Never seen anything like it. Seemed way too bright and big to be a star. I have pics and videos. It was highly unusual.

summary: Was driving car and saw a glowing outline of an object moving irregularly at insane speed.
description: The object appeared (had a glowing outline with an irregular shape similar to pentagon) and immediately plunged down and then pivoted upwards at almost incomprehensible speed (roughly a 90 degree angle). The object maintained the same speed throughout and then completely vanished before my eyes.

summary: Black circle, went up and hovered a moment before taking off to the south at high speed with no sound
description: We were inside the car around 7:00 PM when on the horizon this thing went up and hovered around 10 seconds before flying off at very high speed to the south, it had no lights and made no sound when flying like anything at that speed would do

summary: Green lights in triangular pattern
description: I was driving northbound on 17 in Holly ridge passing 50 and I noticed a red light in the sky that appeared to be moving. It looked similar to the light on a cell tower. I quickly lost sight of it. Then about a mile down the road I noticed the red light again off to my left, about 20 seconds later I saw that It was just a cell tower. Then I saw multiple green lights 3-4 in the center running it's length and then two green lights one on each side going diagonal to the midsection of the other long lights. Almost like the outline of a craft. It was slightly cloudy but that made the lights almost stand out more. It didn't make any noise. This is near the camp lejuine area, I've driven under air craft plenty of time such as helicopters stationary over the road and ospreys passing somewhat low. You know they're there, they're loud, it buzzs your car. There was nothing from this and it appeared to be lower than anything I've seen before.

summary: Car sized UAP/drone travelling at highway-ish speeds just over treetops, no blinking lights. Very low altitude.
description: Wife and I were commuting our usual route, inside our car, windows closed. We had just turned on to Masons Mill Rd off of Byberry heading southwest. We both noticed the lights/object at the same time and let out an expletive. The orientation of lights were in a longer acute triangular pattern of some sort of a large object just over the treetops to our left. We noticed the craft at the same time and saw it for maybe all of 3-5 seconds. The craft was headed pretty much due south, moving slightly away from us at what I would say was highway speeds or faster. The only things we could make out on it were 3 dim amber colored lights, nothing blinking, they were on constantly. These would be much dimmer than the standard FAA lights on commercial flights. I, nor my wife could make out any shape or see anything against the sky, just the lights, and based on the spread of the lights this was not a small craft. I would estimate it to be the size of a car/small suv. The size and its very low altitude shocked us both. I have never seen anything fly that low moving at that pace in the 14 years of living here. The tree canopy height in the park and area near averages at about 20 meters…this was…

summary: Multiple points of light, all moving independently, moving in a general Southeast direction.
description:
On a daily walk, I looked at the sky and saw 1 star moving. Then 3, then 5. I follow them for a while, then look straight up and notice HALF the stars are moving in a general southeast direction. All lights were independently moving. Some were really bright. Some were faint and could only be seen if not looking at them directly. This lasted for at least 5 minutes as more and more kept coming up over the horizon in the Northwest, flying overhead, and continuing towards the Southeast.
I was alone. It was dark. The night sky was crystal clear. Not a cloud in the sky.

The lights were steady and silent, lacking the typical characteristics of conventional aircraft or drones. Their behavior defied immediate explanation, sparking my curiosity and wonder.
I quickly grabbed my phone and took a few photos, hoping to capture the mysterious lights before they disappeared. Upon reviewing the images, the lights appeared just as I had seen them: distinct, bright, and oddly suspended in the air.
As I continued driving, the lights gradually faded into the horizon, leaving me with more questions than answers. The photos I took serve as evidence of this strange encounter, a reminder of the mysterious sight I witnessed on Vollmer Road that day.

'Drone' Sighting Over Immaculata University
description:
Two nights ago, around 7pm, I was driving east on West King Road, passing by Immaculata University in Malvern, Pennsylvania. Out of my driver's side window, I observed a low-flying craft (estimated 120 feet off the ground), which was headed South-East towards my vehicle, just over the university. It
had lights in a strange pattern - unblinking, with a red light prominent and bright near the 'front', and a smaller, dimmer white light near the 'back'. I had first assumed it to be a helicopter, but as it flew closer to my vehicle, it made no noise. It was flying low enough that I would have been able make out it's shape, but the lights were so bright I could not see beyond them. It was also flying extremely slowly, so much so that it never passed over my vehicle, even though it appeared to be just 500 yards away when I first spotted it. I drove along side it for roughly one minute, before losing sight as I continued east. I'd also like to add to my report that I have witnessed multiple other anomaly within the past year and a half in this area - namely, while stargazing, stars that appear to "break off" from the night sky and fly away, often dimming or brightening in the process.…

Cloudy, drizzling sky during the evening, no wind or lighting, powerful and strong light beamed down onto us.
description:
My friends and I were sitting in my car after a meal in a heavily populated area with plenty of buildings and businesses around. All of the sudden every street light began to flicker and go in a sequence, then suddenly after about 15 seconds of that, every light near us went out completely. The only lights were the moon shining, the traffic light, and my headlights. The restaurant where we ate was completely dark with 50+ customers inside still. It’s as though the world had stopped. Of the 3 of us that were in my car, previously chatting, I don’t think any of us breathed in this moment. After the lights had gone completely off, a big bright blue/green light shined from the sky, directly above my car, then it stopped.
I hopped out of the car to look around, as the lights began to turn back on, yet many streetlights began flickering again as I looked around outside the vehicle. I got back in and turned the radio up- it was completely static. Around 1 min after entering my car, a sound, as though a plane was taking off was heard, but this didn’t make sense due to the rainy cloudy weather, and also, it was nearly 8 in the evening and the only airport nearby is a private jet airport.…

They would then move in 360° spinning patterns while forming different shapes. Sometimes the lights would hover in place, other times they would dart off really fast at unnatural speeds, and eventually form back together. It looked like a “space dog fight” sometimes, if that makes sense. The lights would get bright, dim out, and then get bright again. There was no consistent pattern except for they were synchronized in their brightness. As we got closer to Chicago, and the light show, it appeared the lights may have been directly over Lake Michigan or Northern Indiana. We witnessed multiple times at least one or two of the objects descending into Lake Michigan before shooting back into the Flight Levels or Space. Every pilot in the cockpit has seen Starlink on red eyes many times before, this was something completely different. The lights would move around in patterns, not straight lines like Starlink reflecting off the sun. Sometimes the objects looked like they were in…
