summary: At first it looked like low orbit satelite flares, but there were too many and moving a lot in all directions
description:
During a flight from Newark (EWR) to Porto (OPO) at FL330, heading eastbound, we repeatedly observed an object resembling a satellite moving across the sky. The sightings were consistently within the same area, spanning approximately a 10-degree square.
The phenomena exhibited distinct patterns:
1. Faint, Static Lights: Some objects appeared as dim lights, briefly shining at low magnitudes before fading out without moving.
2. Straight-Line Movements: Other objects followed straight trajectories.
3. Formation Movements: A more intriguing pattern involved two or three objects appearing simultaneously, moving in formation. These maintained a consistent distance between them but exhibited non-linear movement. They made synchronized turns, matching speed and direction in perfect unison.
This wasn’t my first encounter with such phenomena, but I had never seen them with such clarity or intensity.
The photographs were taken using a Samsung Galaxy S22+ in Pro mode, and most of them with the following settings: ISO 1600, F2.5, 69mm focal length, and an 8-second exposure. The phone was stabilized, and turbulence during the flight was minimal to nonexistent.
There are many more pictures

summary: Strange light seen in-between freeway exits and wetlands
description:
I was driving home from work on Northbound I-5 and got off on the Laguna Blvd exit.  I always look to the left off me which is part of the Cosumnes River Preserve for any wildlife.  Of course, it was almost 7pm and dark outside.  It's a force of habit for me just to look in that direction for a few seconds as I'm turning with the road away from the interstate.
Like I said, it's dark and I can't see any wildlife.  However, a strange glowing light caught my eye.  It was orange and I'm not completely sure if it was an orb, because the illumination had a fuzzy look to it.  The orange object seemed to be still and hovering either over the tree line or the Sacramento River.   Possibly the orange object could've been over the small town of Courtland.  I'd say the distance between myself, and this object was probably a quart of a mile. The distance from the ground to the object in the sky was maybe 100 feet.
I've become a sky watcher ever seen my first UFO sighting with my grandpa back in 1993.
A couple days later, I texted a friend of mine from church about this sighting.
We typical talk about UFO's and Cryptids after church.  He wasn't at church that Sunday, which is why I texted him my…

summary: No physical object seen fast spinning light in circular motion
description:
I observed a large circular light, approximately 8 to 10 feet in diameter, moving rapidly in a circle with a distinct, hazy white trail following it. The light resembled that of a flashlight in its appearance but was far larger and appeared hazy. It circled rapidly and consistently in a tight pattern above my home and a neighboring home, confined to this specific area.
I did not see any physical object associated with the light, nor could I determine its source. There are no external lights in the area that I can observe with the naked eye that could explain or cause this phenomenon. The light also moved in and out of the clouds, making it difficult to get a completely clear and consistent view.
The sighting began as soon as I arrived home, and the light is still visible as of the time of this report, so I do not have a specific duration for how long it has been present. I captured the event on video but remain unsure of what it could be. Upon contacting a UFO reporting center, I was informed that there have been multiple similar reports recently and was asked to file this report.

As we were watching together it seemed to keep moving to each house headed East, Northeast, until I couldn’t see it.

summary: Saw 5 stationary craft hovering at more than 10k’
description:
The wife and I traveling by car from Noble, OK to our home in North Central AR.
We observed 5 identical in appearance objects hovering in a line perpendicular over HWY 9 near lake Thunderbird and 5-10 miles approximately due south of Tinker AFB.
Each object appeared identical all in a line all spaced equidistant more than a mile apart. Each object had a bright central white light with smaller blinking red and blue lights on each side. The estimated altitude appeared at least 10K’ or more.
We were able to see the objects for around 15 minutes until we drove under them losing sight to the rear of our path of travel. Of the five objects 2 appeared north of HWY 9 and 3 south of it.
It was like we drove under a string of lights with the string between them invisible.
I checked the web site, publicly available, “Flight Radar 24 Live” and saw no aircraft listed as being anywhere close to where observing these object.

summary: V Shaped formation flying in a mist/cloud
description:
I was sitting in the backyard with my dog. It was a mostly clear night. There were lots of stars with a few high thin clouds, some cumulous clouds in the distance, no wind. Something caught my eye to the southwest. At first, I thought there was something wrong with my contacts, because it looked blurry and distorted. Then I realized it looked like a very fast moving cloud. There were 5 lights flying in a V formation surrounded by what looked like a cloud or mist. It was wavering and moving quickly in a northwesterly direction. The lights were round and were softened by the cloud/mist thing that was surrounding them and flying with them. It was not flying at altitude but was also not low to the ground. I couldn’t really see if something was holding it all together, or if the lights were independent of one another. As this flew over the house, 2 of the lights appeared to drop behind the other 3 and overlapped in two rows for a few seconds then reformed into a V. It was completely silent as it flew.
Could this have been drones?

The speed is hard to estimate but the craft moved from horizon to horizon in a matter of 3-5 seconds.

summary: Compact craft flew south along river, shook car and ground, great speeds
description: I was camping at the Duck Spot on the Colorado River in Arizona. After a normal day of camping and turning in at sunset, I woke up a bit after midnight. Unable to go back to sleep, I looked out the car window towards the river and admired the view. It was dark, but once my eyes adjusted I could make out the river and the horizon, and with no light pollution, the stars were bright. Up river, to my right, I heard what sounded like rumbling or thunder. It got closer and louder, and began to physically shake the car I was camping in. I had passed a herd of wild donkeys coming in, and originally thought it might be a stampede. I was still looking out the window of the car towards the river. As the rumbling and noise reached a climax, I saw a compact craft zip down the river in the blink of an eye. It was moving faster than any craft I'd ever seen. Its wingspan did not seem to breach either river bank, and it was flying low to the water, nearly eye to eye with me. It was hard to determine the shape, but I would say a triangle, chevron V shape, or something in between. I saw lights on the craft, but cannot remember how many or what color. If I had to say how many lights, I would say 2 or…

That is when I realized it was not a plane and took my phone out to record it. It continued like that until it was out of sight. If you only watch the video a skeptic may claim it is a boat but you can't see the arc motion from the sky I saw and I believe it would be going too fast for a boat. Possibly a very fast speedboat could go that fast but I saw no bouncing up and down on the water at all and no white wash was visible and no shadow or shape of boat or craft was visible. The light on the boat would have to have been 30 feet above the water also. My phone has too low memory to upload the video right now but the video is on YouTube titled orb hovers across the puget sound. I did include a screenshot from the video…

Then it just abruptly vanished. My name's Taylor and I saw it with Daryl standing next to me on the backpatio of my apartment. It was literally what I had just said to my daughter. My husband did not see the triangle shape – but when I…

summary: We observed what looked like a dim semi circular line. moving through the sky headed southwest.

Appeared to be very high. Looked like a thousand craft in a formation. No light or sound. Followed the formation until in was no longer visible in the south west sky. The object continued east for what looked like 5-10 miles due east and disappeared. No chem trail seen or sound heard.

description: As I was driving south of the A1 motorway from Richmond north Yorkshire back to York. I noticed a very shiny circle in the sky it looked very odd and unusual. There were airplanes in the sky and they was giving out a trail behind them, but this had nothing and I looked around as much as I could but could not see it again. No signs of anything. It wasn't until the next day (today) when I was in my friends work van and told him what I seen I showed him the area I seen it and he told me it is a RAF base there. I am 100% sure what I seen was a ufo as I have never seen anything like this before.

summary: Lights in sky. Not planes or helicopters, didn't move like drones
description: I saw on Facebook that people were seeing unidentified objects in the sky near my house so I went outside, not expecting to see anything. Within a couple minutes I saw four unknown lighted things in the sky. Three were very high up and one appeared lower. They did not make any noise, I could hear (and see) airplanes in the area, but no sound from the things with the lights. They were red, yellow, whiteish yellow, and green lights, all seen from the same direction and flashing in a pattern. The lower one also had extremely bright, bluish white light (much brighter than airplane headlights) on the front. Also, from the front you could not see any of the red, green, yellowish white lights. It was just extremely bright white. It was coming towards me at first, but then turned and I could see the other lights flashing in a pattern. It was not like an airplane where the wing light colors are on opposite sides. The lights were set up in kind of like an elongated short triangle or diamond. The closest one went all the way across the sky and went out of view eventually. The higher ones did the same thing, but they were harder to see because they were very high. They didn't move erratically…

summary: Observed hovering then moving slowly for approximately 25 minutes
Explanation:  Meteor - Possible
description:
Incredibly fast yellow-white light moving and Illuminating clouds from above.
At approximately 9:21pm on Dec 3rd, 2024. The sky was overcast. I took a right from Spicewood Springs Rd. (78731) to North Bound Capital of Texas highway (TX 360 N) traveling approx. NE. After driving about a third of a mile on 360 N, approaching the intersection of Great Hill Trails, to my center-left, I suddenly noticed/saw the clouds brilliantly illuminate, seemingly being lighted from above. From my field of view the size of the illumination was about the size of a soccer ball. Though its shape seemed to be undefined and took the shape of the clouds it was illuminating. The illumination moved incredibly fast from my center-left to left (south to north). I guess a plane or helicopter would take 15-20 seconds to travel the same distance. Due to driving and there being a ~40ft rock ridge bordering the south bound side, my line of site of the illumination was quickly obscured. My destination was in the same direction the light traveled, but I did not see it again. I only saw it for the 2-3 seconds. Possibly a meteor, but did not seem to be traveling downward. Definitely not a ground or helicopter…

summary: Circular object floating above houses that then shot extremely fast vertically into the sky.
description: We saw a circular object floating approximately 25ft above the houses. It was moving horizontally about 5-10mph. We circled around the backroad so we could get a view from the south. The circular object did not seem to be rotating. It was not emitting any smoke or other substances. It was moving slowly along the tree line then shot vertically into the sky at unworldly speed. It seemed like it was meeting another aircraft that looked very similar. The initial aircraft shot into the sky extremely high and met with another aircraft. The 2 objects looked like they were almost touching as that sat beside each other. They then separated by shooting off in opposite direction at an extremely high rate of speed. We lost track of the 2 foreign looking aircraft’s and have not seen them since. Also we have a BMW 535i and the trunk randomly opened while we were driving following the aircraft. The trunk has never randomly opened.

summary: Went from light in sky to giant craft hovering with red green and white lights above me then slowly moved away over trees
Explanation:  Satellites - Probable
description:
Stargazing with Binoculars
I had just received my binoculars on December 3, 2024, and went outside with the intention of trying to spot a UFO. It didn’t take long at all, and I was absolutely shocked by what I saw. I sat in my chair on my back porch (I live in an apartment complex) and pointed my binoculars at a cluster of stars near Algenib, in the Andromeda constellation. I was facing 84° east, looking straight up at the sky when I noticed what looked like something flying by.
I could only describe it as a star because I couldn’t make out its shape. It was bright and had no blinking lights like an airplane, and it was moving incredibly fast. I had to hold the binoculars really steady to keep track of it. I knew it was at a very high altitude, but I couldn’t see a specific shape.
Over the course of 30 minutes, I saw at least 4 different objects moving in the same direction (from north to south, left to right). They were all flying incredibly fast. After each sighting, I double-checked with a flight tracker on my phone to make sure no planes or aircraft were in my area. I live near an airport, so I’m used to seeing planes all the time, but at the times I saw the objects, no…

summary: Witnessed two craft flying low and slow in a large circle

I noticed they were flying opposite each other because at their rate of speed, they were passing me too often for about 5-10 minutes. I do have planes that fly over me constantly, small craft into Teteboro airport, but these were not planes. Multi colored flashing lights.

summary: Large lit floating object in sky
description: Driving down 302, a large lit object caught my eye hovering above a cotton field (maybe further towards state park or srs). It was unusually complex gray, with an upper & lower set of exactly- spaced solid pink-ish lights. This was at sunset, maybe distorting light color. I shouted "what kinda plane is that?" Got goosebumps & realized it was not a usual sky vehicle. Before I could take photo, it disappeared from one side to the next, above tree lines, no obstructions. I turned around and saw nothing. There was enough sunlight left to notice it appeared as one unit. It was on right of & about 4:00-ish, under the moon, for coordinates. It lasted a decent amount of time after notice, maybe 10-30 seconds. Phone couldn't call. Dogs were barking all down the road home & did not see it, again. Silent. Idk if anything else was near it or blasting it because there was some light color change, possibly due to sunlight? It looked like a rectangular? Space craft. I feel strange recalling it but am mostly curious if it's a known object. Military tool, etc. It did not appear to cause harm but there seemed to be a slight bubble surrounding it, an aura. I was not high. I wish I had a photo. This…

They were passing back-and-forth of each other dipping up and down going north the south east west it lasted for about 10 to 12 minutes and then they just sort of finished. summary: Bright yellowish light
description:
I went outside to smoke & noticed what I thought initially was an oblong shaped lighted Christmas display on the ridge.After about 2 minutes noticed it was moving slowly down back up & back down again. At first it was yellow oblong shaped with a little orange at the bottom. I stood up from a seated position & noticed that it then appeared to be more roundish with an orange center & yellowish outer edges with a red light on my left of it. Soon, even more UFOs appeared from all directions, flying in groups and joining the formation. After about 10 minutes, they suddenly broke apart and scattered, flying off in different directions. summary: 20+ stars moving smoothly in all directions around the sky. No distinct pattern. Some in formations.
description:
It was approximately 6:00 PM (give or take 5 minutes). The whole thing lasted no more than 5 minutes.
My wife and I were looking at the sky around 6 PM, when she remarked on how dark the sky seemed. I noticed the stars were clearly visible, and Cassiopeia was centered in our view of the sky.
At first, I thought I saw one of the stars in Cassiopeia move, and then my wife noticed several other "stars" also shifting in the sky. We quickly turned off all nearby lights to observe better.
We saw at least 5 "stars" moving around, possibly more. Initially, I noticed 4 of them in a closing diamond formation that seemed to move downward toward the horizon.
It was then that these stars started showing up all over. There was maybe around 2 dozen, possibly more throughout the whole 5 minutes. There were so many we lost count. Most seemed to move in the direction I would say was north northeast. Tracking them from the top of Cassiopeia to the bottom. But I'm not positive on that direction. As they got close to the horizon you just couldn't see them anymore. I wouldn't say they disappeared. They just faded into the horizon light. They were in no way limited to this direction. Some moved up…

summary: 10-20 fast moving white lights that appeared to be satellites at first but changed directions mid-flight before fading away
description:
Exited my car with my 10 year old daughter. Looked up and saw two white lights traveling side by side with two objects directly behind them (similar to a T shape).
These initial objects continued southeast before turning northeast and fading away shortly afterwards.
Following the initial four objects, at least 10 additional objects (possibly more) followed the same flight path and turned northeast before also fading away.
These objects were spread out significantly more than a starlink launch, these had an estimated five second flight speed delay between them and took several minutes to pass.
They appeared to be traveling significantly faster than a plane that was also visible in the sky at the same time as these objects.
The plane and one of the objects got so close that I thought there may be a collision, but this did not occur.
I have no way to estimate the altitude of the objects.
This also occurred in fairly close distance to both Edgewood and Aberdeen Proving Grounds.

summary: Multiple orbs crossing each other and going into straight line formation and disappearing
description: On 12/3/24 at approximately 5:57pm my husband and I were outside near our back yard, we looked up above the houses and all over the night sky above we started seeing orbs of light traveling. Some were moving in a different zag pattern and others were falling into a straight line of travel. We could see at least 3 different sets of paths of travel of orbs convening into 1 line to travel. My husband and I watched for roughly just under 3 minutes before I texted my mom and dad inside my house to look up outside. Our next door neighbor also came out and watched for a minute before going to get his fiance. At this time I pulled my phone out to record the 2 minute and 20 second long video. We witnessed 200 to 300 orbs travelling in that 5 minutes we watched all of this. I checked starlink and nothing was listed visible for my area at this time. All the things we saw were white in color and brighter than the average star. They could move in all directions and the speed they moved could be sped up or slowed down. Once in formation they were perfectly spaced apart and traveled at the same speed.

summary: Saw approximately 12 or more white orbs in the sky moving in various directions

They moved at different speeds. Some went straight across the sky. Others moved changed directions. At one point, we saw 4 of them equally spaced apart in an arrowhead like formation moving synchronously across the sky. They looked to be in such a synchronous formation that they looked attached, but there was nothing visible but blank sky between them. At one point our daughter came out to find us, and saw them moving in the sky. They made no sound. After 10 or so minutes (maybe 15) we saw less and less of them.

summary: Blue light/object emerged from high cloud cover
description:
I am an electrical engineer with a strong physics background.
The object appeared under high cloud cover probably about 5 miles north of my home, The object made some maneuvers that appeared to be out of the capabilities of human technology. It made both vertical and horizontal movements as it traversed the sky and also made a right hand turn and appeared to move in a strait line in that direction till out of my sight. Total view time was about 4 seconds. I ruled out a drone as the vertical and side to side movements were much faster than a drone is capable. Estimated distance in that travel was probably in the 2 to 3 miles range in that 4 seconds.
Using the high cloud cover as a reference, the object appeared to be small, similar to the size of the light source. The sunset was also not a factor as the whole region was thickly cloud covered.
I also ruled a laser out as there was no scattering as you'd expect when a laser hits a cloud. There was no scattering whatsoever. No noise observed as well.

summary: Los Angeles ORB SIGHTING 12.2.25
description:
I wanted to share my sighting experience along with some images for you of what my husband and I witnessed yesterday driving home on the highway in LA.
We were heading north on the 110 when I spotted what initially looked like a flock of white pelicans flying in the sky. But as I watched, something unusual happened. The "flock" seemed to morph or maybe my perception shifted - into silver spheres darting at high speeds, weaving left and right independently of each other without leaving the cluster.
One of the silver spheres seemed almost aware of my observation, though I can’t explain how I knew that, just felt it. I had a similar experience back in 2015 with three pink orbs (I’ll attach those photos as well). Those objects also seemed conscious of my presence before darting away at an unbelievably fast speed.
Returning to yesterday's sighting: when I started filming, the objects would vanish intermittently. It felt as though they were intentionally trying to appear as birds to mislead anyone watching. However, their movements - the precision, speed, the silver shine - were unmistakably unnatural. Some of my photos even capture their flight path, leaving white streaks in the sky.…

summary: I was walking west 95th, when a bright white chevron 50x faster than a jet flew south 4 secs before disappearing in clear night sky.
description:
I was walking westbound 95th Street passing South Yale when I see a bright white shape fly south with a slightly eastbound tilt for 4 seconds, at inhuman speeds, then INSTANTLY disappearing into the clear night sky.  It did not "fade out" like a transition, it disappeared like magic.
This is chicago, there are no mountains, and on the south side of Chicago there are no tall buildings.
I have traveled the country, and I have also traveled the world with my late, Emmy award-winning Father. Sweden, cancun, germany, london, dubai, Oman Kuwait, Japan, I am CERTAIN what I saw is what they used to call Ufos.
I never even believed in UFOs until I saw it with my own eyes an hour ago at around 9:35 p.m. Central Time.

description:

In both videos there are a few house lights at the bottom horizon level and Venus can be seen in the top left portion of the video as well for reference points.
This is the third time I have seen these lights in the…

summary: I have been fortunate experiencing 3 sightings in the early 70s and in 1966 and "believe" I saw one last night.
description:
I usually always look into the sky hoping for a fourth sighting day and night. last night I witnessed a light moving oddly slow for an aircraft. what got my attention was there were no required port and starboard colored light, just a white light. Then watched light dim slowly and disappear.
My first 3 sightings were obviously UAPs; a parallelogram inverting itself green to blue repeating itself for what I believe was its propulsion system( Aiken SC in 1973. description:
At close to 7:00 pm, I went outside to take the garbage out. As a lover of the beauty of nature, I look up to the sky and admire the moon and stars whenever I go outside at night. The night sky was clear with no clouds and a planet (Venus or Jupiter) was prominent in the south west sky.
After tossing my garbage in the bin and walking back, I observed what I assumed to be stars far above and below the planet. After a few seconds of looking, I noticed the light from these stars didn’t twinkle, but changed between solid white, red and orange. They also appeared to be moving in various directions as if they couldn’t decide which direction to go.
Curious, I pulled out my phone to view through the video camera and get a closer look and shortly after began recording video. I zoomed in a little over halfway on my iPhone 14 Pro Max’s zoom wheel. I tracked one of the objects for a period of time, zooming out to show my perspective and my surroundings and where the objects were. One of the lights in particular caught my attention due to its erratic blinking and quick movement, so I focused my camera on it.
I could not determine any physical structure to the object. It was only visible by the…

Larger than an airplane and if I had to take a guess its altitude was between 8-12,000 ft. It moved constantly from the northeast to the east/southeast. The color of the object was still white but growing and fading back and forth. Kind of like a candle light.
After recording for 31 seconds, I looked at my flight Rader app to verify it wasn’t an airplane because the object wasn’t flashing any lights and wasn’t at the right altitude either coming into our airport (object was flying away from our airport) or leaving from our airport (altitude would have been to high in proximity from airport if object just took off). description:

As sky was transitioning to night, an incredibly bright, white light appeared above us, south to southwest. The light was fixed in its location. It did not move.
The object was closer in proximity than a planet, star, or even a plane, and much larger in size. My guess is that this object was about 10k-20k above ground. No other stars were visible at the time.
My husband and I thought the object was unusual. When we arrived to Chewelah, we pulled out the star viewing app on my husband’s phone. When we held the phone toward the object, the app first glitched and then closed. When we opened the app a second time, the app said it was Jupiter, then quickly adjusted to say the object was Venus. We use this app regularly and this is the first time it’s acted this way.
My husband and I regularly view Venus. We know this object was NOT Venus or Jupiter, it was much closer. This was something else.
After speaking with the relative who’s house we were leaving from that evening, he said he too saw the “bright light” and noted its unusually close proximity, much larger a star or planet in size,…

description:
Description of the Event:
While boarding our boat at Port Motueka, we observed an object flying overhead. Initially, we speculated it might be a drone or satellite, but its altitude appeared too low to be a satellite. The object moved silently, as we could not hear any noise coming from it.
At first, the object seemed to move slowly, but as we departed from the port and headed into Tasman Bay, it rapidly crossed the bay and disappeared over the horizon.
Cloud cover made it challenging to discern its exact shape, but it emitted a bright light that transitioned from a stark white to a warm white as it moved further away. The brightness remained steady despite its speed and distance.
Additional Notes:
• Weather Conditions: Partial cloud cover.
• Duration of Sighting: Approximately 5-8 minutes.
• Distance Covered by the Object: From our perspective, it seemed to traverse Tasman Bay in a relatively short time.
• Witness Thoughts: We were unable to determine whether it was a drone or something else, given its silent movement, brightness, and apparent speed.

summary: Slow-moving light moving low across sky before disappearing.
description: Two coworkers and I were walking to my car after our shift at work. We were walking along the lane in the parking lot that is halfway between Strander Blvd and the purple parking garage, heading south toward my car. My car was parked south and west of the purple garage and southeast of the bank. We were about level with the south end of the garage when I saw it. I was ahead of them and they were behind me, talking. I looked up and saw a light with no apparent source moving very slowly, but very close to us (maybe 15-20 feet above our heads). It was almost directly overhead at first. The light was primarily white but there was a slight tinge of red to it at the edges, and a dim flash of green toward the end. It moved southeast and appeared to go up, before it faded out and quickly disappeared. The vanishing point was about 30 feet from where it started, and about 10 feet higher. It moved diagonally up. The whole thing lasted maybe 3-4 seconds, if I had to estimate it was moving 5-10 mph. I asked my coworkers if they saw the strange light, but they hadn’t. I have never seen or experienced anything like that before, and felt very unsettled by it.

description: Few details in this sighting: I was standing on a street corner and looking south, observed a bright white light, Venus in size or like aircraft headlight move at extreme velocity across the sky, heading either south or down (as though it were going to crash or impact). This is an outter-borough of NYC and there are many flight paths over this area- I see airplanes traverse the sky all the time and have never seen anything this fast. I would say there's the possibility it's a meteor, but I could not see a burn-up as it's path became obscured by the building. Hopefully other reports could elaborate or substantiate further.

summary: Half circle of white lights moving due east then turning to the north.
description:
We were outside in the hot tub when we looked up directly above us and saw a formation in the sky. My very first instinct was that it was a group of geese flying in a formation, but I instantly noticed that they were lights. They were in the shape of a parentheses and spaced out in regular intervals moving directly East. You could only see the lights but when you looked at them it looked like it they were part of a massive ship. As they were moving to the East they were going in and out of the clouds so some of the lights would disappear and then reappear. Within about a minute the lights went completely out of sight due to the cloud cover.
I continued to look for them and about 30 seconds later they reappeared but this time they were turning towards the north in a rather wide sweeping motion. As they made the turn the formation of the lights stayed in the same parentheses form but it seemed like they tightened up a bit. I don’t know if they tightened because I was looking at it from a different angle or if they had shifted directions. They continued to the north until I lost sight of them over the house.
The lights never changed colors and there were no red or green lights, only…

summary: A silent, hovering craft with bright downward-facing spotlights and a blue, solar panel-like underside
description:
The object was silent and appeared to be hovering about 100 feet off the ground.
• It hovered in the same spot over the transformers for about 1 minute, with bright white lights beaming downward from the underside. These lights were so bright that it was difficult to determine if they were strip lights, but they were definitely very intense and shining straight down.
• The underside of the object had a blue, solar panel-like feature, which appeared to be some sort of energy collection or propulsion system.
• The object did not have a back fin or any visible stabilizers like traditional aircraft.
• After hovering for a minute, it slowly moved off and went over the Icon One Daytona apartment complex.
Additional Observations:
• The object did not make any noise, which was unusual given its proximity to residential areas and the airport.
• The movement was slow and deliberate, indicating it was not an ordinary aircraft or drone.

When I looked out the full glass wall window I saw a square object, silver gray in color with lights in each of the corners which varied in intensity. It moved a a steady pace in a straight line from southwest to the northeast. We observed it for about 20-30 seconds and as it got further away it just disappeared. Since we were inside the room, we didn’t hear any sound. The surface was smooth on the side with no visible seams and the bottom had some relief in a pattern with the lights in the four corners. The height was about 1/3 the length of the sides. I sketched what I saw against a photo of the direction and approximate time we saw the object. The scale is close to what we saw.

summary: Occupants and "transforming" drones observed
description:
On 26 November, between the hours of approximately 4:30 and 5:30 PM I was drawn to my back door windows by loud buzzing noises similar to what helicopters would sound like if flying overhead. Looking outside I observed at approximately tree-top level and roughly 200-300 feet away five to seven “drone” aircraft hovering at a stand-still. What caught my surprise was that, while these aircraft looked like small helicopters roughly 8 to 10 feet in length, there were no rotors keeping them aloft nor any engines or blades producing the noise. I did not see any wings, engines, rotors, or means of remaining aloft. These vehicles simply looked like the body of a helicopter (but in miniature) and were projecting a buzzing noise despite having no blades, rotors, etc.
There was a “lead” drone which did *not* look like a helicopter and was significantly larger than the other aircraft. This particular aircraft looked like it was in trouble wobbling erratically, rocking side to side and tipping its center toward me and away from me as it did so. The vehicle was lenticular, biconvex, and looked like a fat donut turned on its side with, oddly, the backside resembling a pinched piecrust. Small…

summary: On the night of November 25, 2024, I was leaving work at the LIU/CW Post Tilles Center in Greenvale (north shore of Nassau County, near Old Brookville, Old Westbury, etc.) just after 10:00pm. As I…
description:
Interestingly, I didn't hear the amount of blade noise I would expect to hear from a helicopter hovering so close-by, so, with the traffic light still red, I rolled down my driver-side window and listened. There were virtually no cars on this quiet country road at this hour on a Monday night, and I immediately noticed that the aircraft was not making any discernible noise.
When the light turned green, it took me all of thirty seconds to dismiss the whole incident, and I proceeded to head toward home in Syosset. Before I had traveled a few hundred feet, however, out of the trees came another one of these "helicopters," arousing my curiosity once again. Still pumped up from the concert I had just worked, I thought for a minute about turning left up Cedar Swamp Road to search for police, ambulance, or fire lights, but decided to abort when I remembered there was a pumpkin pie waiting for me at home.
The traffic light at Wolver Hollow Road and 25A turned red and I came to a stop. As I waited, with no cars anywhere in sight around me, I looked up and, sure enough, a flying object that I had assumed was an airplane had stopped moving and was hovering above 25A, shining a very bright…

summary: Saw a disk-shaped object materialize & shoot off at an impossible speed.
description:
I had just parked my car in the lot of my apartment complex. I was stepping out of the vehicle, slinging my book bag over a shoulder, when I happened to glance up: in the clear night sky overhead—maybe a football field above me—was a darkly-lit, pewter colored UFO. The UFO was roughly 150' in diameter, possibly larger. It was hovering stationary & it was entirely silent. Circular white-green lights patterned a bright ring around its exterior. The lights rapidly flashed sequentially one-by-one in rapid fashion, then went the dark. Like it was winking at me. The craft then shot off in a beam of white-green light toward the northwest horizon at an utterly incomprehensible speed.
I was left quite shaken by the event—my keys were literally trembling in my hand—after seeing the craft depart at such tremendous speed. For that brief moment, I could feel my brain recalibrating around what my eyes had just absorbed. It was as though through the act of witnessing the process of such gravitational impossibility, I, too, became a part of the craft’s immensity: space slowed & time stretched. The light that accompanied the craft's speed was similar to the effect as seen in Millennium Falcon in…

I was spending time with some family members and cousins around a fire pit that they had set up. We were all enjoying the evening, having recently gathered for a wedding. I also tend to casually scan the sky when I'm in my backyard, mostly spotting birds — since our neighborhood is also a bird sanctuary — or various military aircraft, as we live about 10 miles from Naval Air Station Joint Reserve Base New Orleans.
While relaxing and listening to music playing from one of my cousin’s phones, I remember casually wondering about the possibility of seeing something strange earlier that night as I've thought so on few occasions while out and around our house. It was sometime between 9:50 PM and 10:20 PM when I looked up toward the northwest and noticed something entering my field of vision — a very large formation of bright white lights, arranged in a V-shape, though more like a right angle than a sharp V.
It wasn’t immediately clear whether the lights were connected to a solid craft or not, as it was a fairly clear night and I couldn’t make out any…

summary: Crescent shape and no noise
description: Was getting out of my hot tub and noticed out of the corner of my eye something moving in the sky. I looked up and noticed a humongous object that was shaped like a horizontal crescent moving from east to west. It was very wide, up to 100 yards in width at appearance . There was no noise . I couldn't make out what exactly was in the center but it appeared the front had a smooth curve to it. The tips on the object were very pointed as well. It seemingly accelerated at the end of my visibility of the object.

summary: Crescent shaped. No noise 100-200 yards wide
description: I was getting out of my hot tub and noticed something in the sky. At first I thought it was a cloud moving fast but when I finally locked my eyes onto it I could see a huge maybe 100-200 yard crescent shaped object in the sky. I stared at it in amazement and then when I saw it moving under clouds/ stars and blocking them out was when it startled me. It made no noise and moved at a fast steady pace. It has sharp tips on each end and the front was rounded with something in the center I couldn't make out. It appeared to be trying to blend in with the night sky. I was really shocked and ran in the house to get my daughter to see what I was seeing but it has flew past our sight. I'm reporting this in hopes other who saw (if any did) can help verify my sighting.

summary: Huge perfect circle orb zipping in a low arc across the night sky.
description: That evening I was out walking the dogs and as I was looking south down the valley and towards the city I witnessed an absolutely huge perfectly round yellow/orange craft zip through the air in a perfect arc east to west. There were clouds in the sky in that direction but that didn’t impact its visibility. I would say the entire event lasted 3-4 seconds. It’s wasn’t a meteor, way too big. It wasn’t a plane/helicopter or drone… again, way too big. And it had a very steady and super sonic speed for something that large. It was so large and so bright that it’s burned in to my mind. Like when you stare at the Sun too long. How do I say this without sounding crazy but I knew I was witnessing something special. Like it wanted me to see. I can’t stop thinking about it and replaying it in my brain. That sounds crazy to say out loud. I waited a while to report this BUT something’s telling me I should. I wonder everyday if I’ll see it again or if anyone else witnessed what I did that night.

description: I saw a sphere near the horizon silhouetted against the brighter clouds at sunset. I was looking towards the Southwest from a cruise ship traveling north off the coast of Baja California. It seemed to have some horizontal motion towards the south, but it was difficult to assess due to the movement of the ship. I could not estimate the distance to the object, but it did not seem very close. However, I was able to see a distinct shape versus a blurry one. I could not see any details besides the spherical shape or any lights. Due to the distance being unknown, I could estimate the size of the object. I was not able to take a picture in time to capture my viewing. I do not know if anyone else on the ship saw the object. The cruise ship was the Norwegian Bliss.

The following analysis was priovide by a user on Reddit, suggesting that these may be C-130's:

If you go into the replay mode, you can see them passing over that exact intersection ([PA-15 and Mountain Road] at 1730z on November 21st, earlier in the day of the reported sighting.

Then as we were watching it, it just...blinked out. Disappeared. We both let out an audible WHOAH and stood there watching the now empty spot of sky. The…

I witnessed the object slowly move across the sky towards the west for a few minutes. Eventually it moved far enough that it was about to leave my eyesight so I walked north and crossed the roadway to stay in the view of it. While about to cross the street is when I snapped two photos of it. Even my phone camera would not…

summary: Saw a fireball flying above an apt complex
description:
I recently moved from Denver to a suburb where there's a great view of the open sky and much less light pollution than where I lived before. I was standing outside of my front door which faces an apt complex and I was thinking to myself that while I have a better view of the sky than before, I haven't seen anything abnormal since I moved here. Right as I had that thought, I saw a fireball moving directly above the apt complex 5-7 ft. that was yellowish-orange with an orange outline around it moving north to south before dipping slightly (as if it was falling to the ground), then disappearing right in front of my eyes. It only lasted 4 or 5 seconds, but it was a silent ball of fire. I've never seen one of these before, so it kind of freaked me out a bit. I have no idea what it was, but I knew that it wasn't normal.
A couple of days later, I ran into a neighbor and I told him about it and he told me that he caught a couple of weird things in the sky with his phone and he was afraid to tell anyone for fear of people thinking he was crazy. One of the objects he captured was a bluish-white spiral heading towards earth, stopping on a dime, then darting back up into the sky and…

summary: Multiple Orbs spotted
description:
On November 17, 2024, around 7:45 PM, I observed multiple Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAPs) in the sky near a street lamp. The weather was slightly cloudy with no stars visible. The UAPs were located in the sky near the moon. Behind them was a dense area of woods.
I was able to capture some footage on my camera, although the objects were visible to the naked eye much better than they appeared in the video. The objects were moving rapidly in the sky in various patterns—some appeared to be stationary while others zipped through the air unpredictably. There were about a dozen or more objects in total, some with faint red and green flashing lights, though not all were illuminated.
One of the UAPs seemed to move toward me as I filmed. Despite their high altitude, I could clearly see their bright, white appearance. The objects were small relative to their height in the sky and moved with varying speeds—sometimes rapidly, sometimes gliding slowly. They also appeared to hover for periods of time.
I caught an odd sound in the video, that I believe to come from the UAP, but i am unsure of the source of the sound. When the sound is heard you can then hear dogs barking and sirens followed…

summary: Moved and stopped 3 times in different directions with strange waving flair at each stop. Accelerated quickly north fading into blue.
description:
I was helping my friend, replacing deck boards in his back yard. It was a clear, cool, dry day with jets flying over on the approach to Pensacola Airport. I stood up to stretch my back and watched a small executive jet fly over. An outbound plane caught my eye overhead ~ double the altitude. It was really bright, and I thought it was the sun reflecting off the bay water lighting it up. After watching it move West a few seconds it stopped, no sound and no wings. A few seconds later it moved slowly to the North, stopping with a wobble side to side. A few seconds later it moved slowly Northeast, stopping again with a wobble. At that point I yelled to my friend who had his face down repairing his deck. He started laughing and thought I was joking. As he slowing got up I was pointing at it and yelling. The craft accelerated North and faded into blue in under 3 seconds, traveling a great distance. My last view was a yellow to orange color before the blue of the sky covered it. By the time my friend got up to look where I was pointing it was gone. He still thinks I'm crazy.

At the time, I did not observe anything unusual with the naked eye.
The image appears to show a oval, orb-like object at a fairly high altitude, seemingly in motion. Based on its apparent size, clarity, and position in the sky, it does not resemble an aircraft, helicopter, bird, drone or balloon that I am familiar with. What is most striking to me is that the date this picture was taken (Saturday 2 November, 2024) and location coincide with the period during which multiple unexplained aerial sightings in the NYC and New Jersey area were reported in the media. Furthermore, doing a quick research, I found out that it seems to match in sorts the course and general shape of another object caught this time on video, also flying over the Hudson / East River early November, as shown in local news reports at the time.
I am a tourist from France with no professional background in aviation…

description:
Static light that comes from a mountain and disappears after being static for a moment
A light that comes from a hill and, at a certain height above it, remains static with an amber color. It begins to constantly maximize and minimize its size until it becomes small and white. Then, it starts to move westward from its starting point until the light becomes imperceptible after moving for 10 to 15 seconds. This happens very frequently, and at times, this light is accompanied by another smaller one that follows the same path or returns to the hill.
Original report in Spanish:

Comienza a maximizar y minimizar su tamaño constantemente hasta que queda en un tamaño pequeño y de color blanco. Luego, comienza a avanzar hacia el oeste desde su punto de partida, hasta que la luz queda imperceptible después de avanzar durante 10 a 15 segundos. Esto sucede muy frecuentemente y, en ocasiones, esta luz se ve acompañada de otra más pequeña que hace el mismo recorrido, o regresa al cerro.

I continued to change my focus from driving and then back to the sky. I had been working on ways to debunk, I have seen reflections from airplanes in the sun before but this object was stationary. I then had taken the exit I needed which is 182 Hermiston/ Lexington. I take this everyday for work five days a week and often times in the spring in summer on the weekends to get farm supplies. This route is traveled often with no other oddities noted.

description: I am an instrument rated pilot and I have flown to Savannah several times, so I am familiar with the airspace, traffic, etc. We were at the rooftop bar, Rocks on the Roof, that is nine stories above the river. I had just sat down with my buddy, and I had only two sips of my drink. I was facing west towards the big bridge that crosses the river. Visability was excellent at over 10 miles, and there were no clouds in the sky. Suddenly I saw two orange lights flying north to south across the river with a faint string of smaller orange lights twinkling between them. The distance between the two orange lights did not change, and from my perspective the formation was a diagonal line from Southeast to Northwest moving at a speed I estimated to be about 7000 mph! The lights appeared as they zoomed across the river up in the sky at an estimated altitude of about 5000 feet, and about 5 miles away. They were above the horizon just over the height of the towers of the big bridge. The first thought I had was that they vaguely reminded me of the footage of Iranian rockets raining down on Tel Aviv (at that moment Israel was striking back at Iran), but these were not moving in a balistic arcing…

summary: White lights
description: Myself, my husband, and our 6 year old child had driven up to a recreation area out of the city in the foothills of the mountains to get a view of the (I think it was the Tsuchinshan-ATLAS) comet. My husband walked up the hill and under the trees, so he was not with us in the parking lot when we had the sighting. We were viewing west with binoculars to get our sights on the comet, which we found above the tree line and upslope of the mountain. Presently, we saw a shooting star in the same vicinity. A few minutes later, we looked up again and saw a series of white lights slightly to the north of the comet (but still within the same sight-view). It was difficult to discern the distance and size of the series of lights, but it seemed obvious to us that the many lights were part of one large object. After a moment, we could tell that it was moving toward our direction. The lights were oriented in a straight line and at approximately a 60 degree angle. There was one larger light at the top end, and set back a space behind, a series of perhaps ten smaller white lights. My son and I perceived the exact details of this object differently. We agree on these basics of the description, but…

summary: Black Triangle flying above and along power lines

description: My husband and I were driving home. He was driving and I was using the opportunity to look out the window at the sky. I was curious if the comet was still visible so I was scanning the sky which was clear. As we got a couple of blocks from our home I saw this strange object. It was capsule or cigar shaped. Thicker than a cigar in proportion. It appeared dark gray with light gray window like patches along its side. We were turning corners so it was difficult to keep it in sight. I kept asking my husband "Do you see that?" It took three or four minutes to pull into our driveway and get out of the car. I was so enthralled watching it that I just didn't think of taking a picture. (I am an older person and don't think to grab my phone as a first reaction) It was moving slowly eastward. As I stood and watched the front end began to disappear. It was like it was moving into a slit in the sky. It took about 6-7 seconds for it to disappear completely. There was no sound at any point.

summary: Silver/metallic orb flying northwest
description:
The sighting occurred on Saturday, October 26, between 2 and 4 p.m. (I do not remember the exact time). I was poolside at the hotel. The sky was perfectly blue and completely cloudless.
As I looked up at the sky, I noticed a perfectly round, silver/metallic object. It was shiny and reflecting the daylight. It was moving across my line of sight from left to right in a north/northwest direction. I followed the flight path of the object for approximately 8-10 seconds before it disappeared behind a structure. I repositioned and attempted to find the object, but I was unable to relocate it.
The object moved in a perfectly straight line and at a uniform speed. It had no evident propulsion system or airframe. The object appeared perfectly round, similar to a ball bearing. It did not leave behind any sort of trail or evidence of burning fuel. It was also completely silent.
Living near John Wayne Airport, I regularly see all kinds of planes as well as helicopters. I have also seen multiple Starlink satellites and launches. I can therefore say with certainty that what I saw was not an airplane, helicopter, or satellite. As I regularly see planes and helicopters in flight, I also have a good…

I would estimate the object to have been at a minimum of one thousand feet long. There were several airplanes in the sky towards the north which were normal. It was hovering in the shape of a backslash on a keyboard. It didn't seem to moving any specific direction. It was the largest thing I've seen in the sky. After about one minute and thirty seconds, the lights went out.

Abnormal shaped craft, appeared stationary and rotated to present the same side towards me as I passed at 11,000ft MSL
description:
Cruising level at 11,000MSL over the appalachian mountains when out of the corner of my eye I saw a strange shaped object appear at roughly 11:00 position relative to my direction of travel (southeast bound). I watched for a handful of seconds as we passed the object, which did not appear to be moving laterally or vertically, but did seem to turn with my movement, so as to present the same side of itself towards me as I passed it. The object was white and has no defining features but also didn’t have any obvious source of propulsion. While scale is difficult to estimate, my best guess is the object passed within 100yds of my left wing, and was roughly 2-3 ft wide and 2 ft tall.

summary: Multi-colored orb seen moving in random pattern in the night sky.
description:
**Weather and Visibility Conditions:**
The skies were clear with no cloud cover, making for excellent observing conditions. There was little to no wind, and no precipitation.
**Description of the Object:**
The object was orb-shaped and initially appeared similar to a star in the sky. Upon closer inspection, it was clear that it was not a star. The object displayed rapidly shifting colors, transitioning between red, white, blue, and purple. These flashing colors had a slight translucent quality, adding to its unusual appearance. The object appeared to be about the same size as Venus when observed from the ground.
The object performed several rapid movements in multiple directions, following a seemingly random, zigzag-like pattern. It moved with precision and speed that seemed impossible for conventional aircraft. Throughout the sighting, no sound was heard coming from the object. The entire event lasted approximately 10 minutes.
**Witnesses:**
I, along with my brother, witnessed the event while stargazing. At the time, I was also engaged in astrophotography using a tripod. My brother first noticed the object, observing its movement and shifting colors. Initially, I believed it to…

Saw a line of three lights with two smaller lights in between. All the same color.
description: During the early morning I saw three bright white lights in a row, with two smaller lights in between the larger lights. It was flying above the apartments from where I live. At first I thought it was a low flying crop airplane, but it was too bright and large to be a plane of that size. Then I thought perhaps it was a regular airplane. However, it was much too low and silent. Airplanes fly over our home all the time at different altitudes so I'm very familiar with how they look and sound. It was flying toward my direction, then it turned slightly to my left, then it slowly and completely disappeared. There was no noise. No viewable parts of an aircraft other than the lights. The fade was unmistakable. Then it was gone. There were no clouds in the sky. It was a nice, calm morning. Strangest thing I've ever seen. I haven't seen anything like it before or since that day.

summary: Large V-Shaped Formation Spotted.
description:
A helicopter approached the formation and stopped, hovering for approximately 20 minutes.
Shortly after, another light appeared on the opposite side of the "V."

All objects, including the helicopter, remained stationary for 20 minutes. The V-shaped formation then moved at high speed, followed by the single light. The helicopter departed shortly thereafter.
When asked about this event, an Air Force pilot who witnessed it stated that he had no idea what it was.
Note: Enlarge the photo to see the single light in the upper right corner. This is not a reflection from roof lights.

description:
I saw what appeared to be a very odd shaped balloon rising from town
On Oct 15 2024, at approx 5: 40 pm I went out to my driveway to do chores. While I was out, I looked up and saw what appeared to be a balloon, rising (as a helium balloon would) away from my immediate neighborhood. I first noticed it at about 250 feet above me.
It appeared to be a black faceted balloon with a line dangling approximately 6' below the object with a small payload. What caught my attention was the movement and dark color. After observing it for just a few seconds I pulled out my phone (Samsung S22Ultra) and began filming it at 10x optical zoom. As it rose away, I changed to digital zoom (ultimately up to 100x digital). After filming for 28 seconds, I went inside to get my binoculars. When I came out it had risen too far to regain sight.
The object appeared dark (black) and cubic but with curious facets, They did not appear 'bulging' (as a balloon would be) but rather somewhat concave. It appeared to have a cubic 'wire-ish' structure wrapped taught material that had a vacuum inside - pulling the surface in.
Dangling from below the object was a non rigid line of some sort with a small 'payload'…

summary: Amorphous but angular changing shapes, Non repeating shapes, approx the size of a semi trailer a few 100 feet off the ground.
description:
43 year old white male, lower middle class lives in the area.
I was on my way to yoga at 9:30am on October 14th, while driving east on Edison Furlong road I saw something floating in the sky. It wasn't any plane shape I have ever seen and initially thought is this a large bouncy castle in the sky? floating and changing shapes. the best I can describe is, forms going ins and out and the folds and angles changing slowly but some extreme shapes. For a second I thought maybe an unconventional aircraft, maybe a paraglider or something. As I approached closer to where the object is hovering all while keeping it in my sights, I could tell it was roughly above the parking lot, more towards over York Road but basically over where I was going to park. I thought to myself, I'll take a photo of it when I park, then I thought this stupid, why not take a video instead. Unfortunately this is where the "high strangeness" type phenomenon happens.
The minute I parked, I completely forgot about the sighting till roughly 48 hours later. I didn't believe in anything mind control or ESP related previous to this experience. And I self admittedly, am and have always been interested in the subject of NHI.

summary: I saw a rectangular craft emerge from a ripple in the sky, descend, and vanish like a train entering a tunnel.
description:
On the night of September 30th, 2024, at around 10:00 p.m., I looked up at the stars and witnessed something extraordinary. At first, it appeared as if someone was projecting an image onto the sky, like a movie projector beaming into space. Then, I saw a circular motion, similar to the ripple effect of a coin dropped into water.
Through the center of this ripple appeared a rectangular-shaped object, descending at an angle. Within about 15 seconds, it seemed to enter a tunnel—vanishing from front to back, much like a train disappearing into a tunnel.
The object was rectangular with vertical lines running from top to bottom, dividing it into five sections. In the center of each section, there appeared to be a light or possibly an illuminated marking. The symmetry of the object was striking.
A friend who was with me also witnessed the event. We both sketched what we saw, and our drawings matched, confirming that our observations were the same. The craft showed no apparent interest in Earth; it simply continued on its trajectory, traveling in a straight path.

summary: While camping, saw a white light emit a blue "skirt" of luminous light, unlike any aircraft or natural phenomenon.
description:
While camping, I observed a single white light moving steadily across the sky. Initially, I assumed it was an airplane or satellite because of its linear trajectory and steady brightness. However, as I watched, the light began to emit a remarkable phenomenon. A skirt-like pattern of blue light appeared below it, resembling luminous water cascading from the object. The blue light seemed to radiate smoothly and uniformly, unlike anything I’ve ever seen from an aircraft, satellite, or natural phenomenon. It was like the white dot (light) eject what looked like vast amounts of blue, glowing "water," creating a stunning effect.
The light maintained its original path and speed without blinking, and there were no audible sounds. This event lasted approximately 3 min before the light moved out of sight.

description:
While driving home from a small gathering, my girlfriend and I saw a glowing orange triangle hovering silently in the sky over a field just outside Plaisance, Louisiana. The glow was steady, not blinking or flickering.
There were no flashing lights, no movement, and it did not resemble any known aircraft, drone, flare, or reflection. It was clearly distinct from a nearby radio tower (which had red blinking lights aligned vertically) and from the moon (also visible, in a different part of the sky). The triangle seemed to “close in” from the sides as we passed, possibly due to the shifting angle or clouds, but remained motionless the entire time.
If it had been nearby—say, at the edge of the field—it would’ve spanned over 100 yards in base length. If it was distant, it must’ve been enormous. We heard no sound, though our vehicle was loud. My girlfriend saw it clearly and described it before I did, confirming it wasn’t imagined or a trick of the eye.

summary: I was in a car traveling to another destination and I see strange lights thinking it was the moon but as I look closer something is off
Spherical object flew Eastward at constant speed and elevation, no lights, no sound, no deviation from course.
description:
While standing outside just after 7PM on a clear summer evening, I observed a black or possibly metallic spherical object flying high in the sky. Based on its appearance and behavior, I estimate it was at least 30,000 feet up—possibly higher or lower depending on its true size, which was hard to judge due to the lack of reference. It moved in a perfectly straight line from west to east, toward Lake Michigan, at a constant speed and unchanging altitude.
It did not emit any light, left no contrail, and made no sound. The sun was beginning to set, so the object was silhouetted dark against the sky, which made me suspect it was metallic. It did not resemble a commercial jet, drone, or balloon. It also did not follow an arc like a satellite—it was clearly within the atmosphere.
The sky was cloudless. There were no other witnesses I could see, which felt strange for such a beautiful summer evening. I considered photographing it but chose not to, believing no one would believe me regardless.
I checked public flight paths and satellite passes later that evening—nothing matched. I have no conventional explanation for what I saw. This was my first UFO sighting and it gave me chills.

On April 8, 2024 I observed a highly reflective triangular object from my balcony in Las Vegas, Clark County, NV. The sighting was roughly 7–8 minutes after the visible end of the partial solar eclipse (estimated local time ~12:38 PM PDT). The sky was mostly clear.
The object initially appeared moving east across the sky. As it turned north it appeared to rotate/flip (the triangular shape was evident during approach), and then — after the flip/rotation — it completely disappeared from view within a fraction of a second. There were no clouds in the direction it vanished that could have concealed it; the object did not leave a contrail or produce sound that I could hear from my balcony. It looked silver and highly reflective — when angled it flashed; when it flipped the flash vanished. I do not have photos or video. I estimate overall observation time at under two minutes, with the flip/vanish happening almost instantly.

summary: Oval object flies by in daylight
Explanation:  Drones - Possible
description:
Saw 2 small orbs very high in broad daylight
My wife and I were attending a Preview Day event at Marion Military Institute in Marion, Alabama, on April 5, 2024. Around midday, while standing on the drill field, we noticed two small, white orbs very high in the sky. The weather was mostly clear with a few high-altitude clouds, and visibility was good.
The two objects flew side-by-side at the same altitude and speed, initially appearing to behave like drones—possibly from Maxwell Air Force Base. However, what struck us as unusual was their flight pattern: they would move apart in large, synchronized semi-circles and then return to flying in parallel. This maneuver repeated with precise timing and symmetry.
The movements were smooth and silent, with no vapor trails, flashing lights, or sound. They were too high to capture on an iPhone camera. As someone familiar with conventional aircraft and drones, I found the formation and movement unlike anything I’ve ever seen. The coordinated, arcing separation—executed without banking or turning like a plane—seemed to defy known aerial behavior.
We observed the event for several minutes until the objects either faded from view or moved out of…

summary: Low Rocket Like Bass Sound That Traveled West To North-East Lasting Around 5 Minutes
description:
On February 4th, 2024, between approximately 2:45 and 3:00 AM, I heard an unexplained low-frequency sound while at my home in a rural area outside Montgomery, Pennsylvania. It was a cold winter's night with cloudy skies and a last-quarter moon. The environment was unusually quiet before and during the incident.
The sound I heard was a steady, constant low rumbling that resembled a rocket engine. It had a slightly mechanical quality to it, not fluctuating or pulsing, just a consistent deep tone. I didn’t see any lights or any visible craft, but the sound seemed to come from above the cloud layer while also giving the impression of being low, almost near the treetops. I first noticed it when the water in my cup began vibrating slightly from the low-frequency resonance. The sound lasted for about five minutes.
The sound moved across the sky from west to southeast. As it faded into the distance, it dropped to almost nothing, then briefly surged back up to around half its original volume before quickly fading out completely. After the sound vanished, the night remained extremely quiet for a moment until the usual night creatures began making noise again. There was no shaking of the…

summary: Two craft of the same shape with orange glow in centre, flew immensely fast over the city before dissapearing behind shooting star

I suspect a drone craft of some kind the way the two flew in formation, perfectly matching incredible speeds, dead silent in the night.
(As if perhaps there should've been a third?)
Regardless of whether it was a government drone or an advanced craft.
I was left stunned, speechless, and in tears with all hairs standing on end.
They were close enough to see, so maybe a comercial airliner altitude, but the speed they had was twice to three times that of a sattelite, combined with their dissapearing behind the only shooting star I've seen in weeks (habitual ciggy break taker of the outdoors at night)
